'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī nā ma siṅgā ti/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mchan yang dag par brjod pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /gdul dka' 'dul ba rnams kyi mchog /dpa' bo 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /rdo rje dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal/ /pad+ma dkar po rgyas 'dra'i spyan/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rang gi lag gis rdo rje mchog /yang dang yang du gsor byed pa/ /khro gnyer rim par ldan la sogs/ /lag na rdo rje mtha' yas pa /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /'jigs su rung dang dpa' byed can/ /rdo rje rtse mo rab 'phro ba/ /rang gi lag gis gsor byed pa/ /snying rje che dang shes rab dang / /thabs kyis 'gro don byed pa'i mchog/dga' mgu rangs pa'i bsam pa can/ /khro bo'i lus kyi gzugs ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas phrin las byed pa'i mgon/ /lus btud rnams 1

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/dang lhan cig tu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal nas/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni/ /spyan sngar 'dug ste 'di skad gsol/ /khyab bdag bdag la sman pa dang / /bdag don bdag la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba mngon rdzogs pa'i/ /byang chub ci nas bdag thob mdzod/ /nyon mongs pas ni sems dkrugs shing / /mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi/ /sems can kun la sman pa dang / /bla med 'bras bu 'thob bya'i phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa po//dam tshig chen po de nyid mkhyen/ /dbang po bsam pa mkhyen mchog gis/ /bcom lngen 'das kyi ye r+shas pa/ /gtsag tor chen po tshig gi — ni / rir 5 ris mi /bdag /ye shes sku ste rang byung ba / /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yi/ /ming ni yang dag brjod pa'i mchog /don zab don ni rgya che zhing / /don chen mchungs med rab zhi ba/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang dang yang du gsung ba gang / /rgyud chen sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ /rdo rje 'chang chen gsang sngags 'chang / /dpag med rnams kyi dga' ༵zhin du/ /glu blangs gang lags bshad du gsol/ /mgon po rdzogs

'jam/ dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /gsang 'dzin ci nas bdag 'gyur phyir/ /nges pa ra 'byung gi bar du ni/ /bdag gi bsam pa brtan pos gzung / /nyon mongs ma lus bsal ba dang / /mi shes ma lus spang ba'i phyir/ /bsam pa'i khyad par ji bzhin du/ /sems can rnams la bshad par 'chal/ /gsang dbang lag na rdo rje yis/ /de bzhin gshegs la de skad du/ /gsol nas thal mo sbyar byas te/ /lus btud nas ni spyan sngar 'dug /de nas bcom ldan shākya thub/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog /nyid kyi zhal nas ljags bzang ba/ /ring zhing yangs pa brkyang mjad de/ /'jig rten gsum po snang byed cing / /bdud bzhi'i dgra rnams 'dul byed pa/ /sems can rnams kyi ngan song gsum/ /sbyong bar byed pa'i 'dzum bstan nas/ /tshangs pa'i gsungs ni snyan pa yis/ /'jig rten gsum po kun bkang nas/ /lag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /gsang dbang la ni slar gsungs pa/ /snying rje che dang ldan gyur pas/ /'gro la phan pa'i don du khyod/ /ye shes lus can 'jam dpal gyi/ /ming brjod pa ni don che ba/ /dag par byed cing sdig sel ba/ /nga las nyan par brtson pa ni/ /legs so dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /lag na rdo rje khyod legs so/ /gsang ba'i bdag/ po de phyir ngas/ /khyod la legs par bstar bar bya/ /khyod 3

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/ni rtse gcig yid kyis nyon/ /bcom ldan de ni legs zhes gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan shākya thub/ /gsang sngags rigs chen thams cad dang/ /gsang sngags ri gas sngags 'chang ba'i rigs/ /rigs gsum la ni rnam par gzigs/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i rigs/ /'jig rten snang byed rigs chen dang / /phyag rgya chen po'i rigs mchog dang / rigs chen gtsug tor cher gzigs nas/ /tshig gi bdag pos tshigs su bcad/ /gsang sngags rgyal po drug ldan zhing / /gnyis su med par 'byung ba dang / /mi skye'i chos can 'di gsungs pa/ /a ā i sī u lū e i tse( skyes e āḥ sbi to hrī di/ dz+nyā na mū n+ti ra haṃ thudro/ hrū nai tru dh+waban+ti nī/ oṃ badz+ra tīkyā duḥkha ts+tsha da/pradz+nyā dz+nyā nā mūrtaye/ dz+nyā na kā ya wā gī shwa ra/ a ra pa ca nā ya te na maḥ'adi ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas a las byung / /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yige dam pa yin/ /khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med/ /chig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /chig kun rab tu gsal bar byed/ /mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /sems can thams cad/ dga' bar byed/ /mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che/ /nyon mongs kun gyi ༵gra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /gti mug blo ste gti mug

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/sel/ /mchod pa chen po khro ba che/ /khro ba chen po dgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /chags pa thams cad sel bar byed/ /'dod pa chen po bde ba che/ /dga' ba chen po mgu ba che/ /gzugs che lus kyang che ba ste/ /kha dog che zhing lus bong che/ /ming yang che zhing rgya che ba/ /dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa yin/ /shes rab mtshon chen 'chang ba ste/ /nyon mongs chen po'i lcags kyu mchog /grags chen snyan grags chen po ste/ /snang ba chen po gsal ba che/ /mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang / /sgyu 'phrul chen po don sgrub pa/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po'i dga' bas dga'/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po'i mig 'phrul can/ /sbyin bdag chen po gtso bo ste/ /tshul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog /bzod chen 'chang ba brtan pa po/ /brtson 'grus chen po brtul ba yin/ /bsam gtan chen po'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /shes rab chen po'i lus 'chang ba/ /stobs po che la thabs che ba/ /smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med/ /snying rje chen po blo yi mchog /shes rab chen po blo chen ldan/ /mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs dang ldan/ khri1gas chen mgyogs pa chen po ste/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po cher grags pa/ /stobs chen pha rol gnon pa po/ /srid pa'i ri bo chen po 'joms/ /5

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/mkhrigs shing rdo rje chen po 'chang / /drag po chen po drag shul che/ /'jigs chen 'jigs par byed pa po/ /mgon po rig mchog chen po ste/ /bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i mchog /theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas/ /theg pa chen po'i tshul gyi mchog /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /thub pa chen po thub chen ldan/ /gsang sngags chul chen las byung ba/ /gsang sngags tshul chen bdag nyid can/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa ste/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu la gnas/ /pha rol phyin bcu dag pa ste/ /pha rol phyin pa bcu yi tshul/ /mgon po sa r+sā'i dbang phyug ste/ /sa bcu la ni gnas pa po/ /shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can/ /shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po/ /rnam pa bcu po don bcu'i don/ /thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag /kun gyi don ni ma lus byed/ /rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po/ /thog ma med pa spros med bdag /de bzhin nyid bdag dag pa'i bdag /bden par smra zhing tshig mi 'gyur/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin byed/ /gnyis su med dngaganyis med ston/ /yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas/ /bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ /mu stegs ri dwags ngan 'jigs byed/ /kan ṅka 'gro ba'i don yod stobs/ /de bzhin glogs pa'i yid lar ni/sgo /ji 8 //kā/ / no//te~Xgyogs/ /rgyal ba dgra rgyal rnam par rgyal/ /'khor lo sgyur ba

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/stobs po che/ /tshogs kyi slob dpon tshogs kyi mchog /tshogs rje tshogs bdag dbang dang ldan/ /mthu chen gces par 'dzin pa ste/ /chul chen gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog /tshig rje tshig bdag smra mkhas pa/ /tshig la dbang ba tshig mtha' yas/ /tshig bden pa dang bden par smra/ /bden pa bzhi ni ston pa po/ /phyir mi ldog pa phyir mi 'ong / /'dren pa rang rgyal bse ru'i tshul/ /nges 'byung sna tshogs las 'byung ba/ /'byung ba chen po rgyu gcig po/ /dge slong dgra bcom zag pa zad/ /'dod chags bral bas dbang po thul/ /bde ba rnyed pas 'jigs med thob/ /bsil bar gyur pas rnyog pa med/ /rig pa dang ni rkang par ldan/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten rig pa'i mchog /bdag gir mi 'dzin ngar mi 'dzin/ /bden pa gnyis kyi tshul la gnas/ /'khor ba'i pha rol mthar son pa/ /bya ba byas pas skam sar gnas/ /shes pa 'ba' zhig nges gsal ba/ /shes rab mtshon chas rnam 'joms pa/ /dam chos chos rgyal bsal bar ldan/ /'jig rten snang bar byed pa'i mchog /chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal/ /legs pa'i lam ni ston pa po/ /don grub bsam pa 'grub pa ste/ /kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog dbyings mi zad/ /chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes/ /bsod nams ldan pa bsod nams 7

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/tshogs/ /ye shes ye shes 'byung gnas che/ /ye shes ldan pa yod med shes/ /tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po/ /rtag pa kun rgyal rnal 'byor can/ /bsam gtan bsam bya blo ldan mchog /so so rang rig mi g.yo ba/ /mchog gi dang po sku gsum 'chang / /sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can/ /spyan lnga chags pa med pa 'chang sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa po/ /sangs rgyas sras po dam pa'i mchog /shes pas srid 'byung skye gnas med/ /chos las 'byung ba srid pa sel/ /gcig pu sra mkhregs rdo rjeli bdag /skyes ma thag tu 'gro ba'i bdag /nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ /shes rab ye shes me po che/ /'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron/ /gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba/ /sngags mchog mnga' bdag rig sngags rgyal/ /gsang sngags rgyal po don chen byed/ /gtsug tor chen po rmad byung gtsug /nam mkha'i bdag po sna tshogs ston/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag dngos po mchog /'gro kun dga' ba'i mig dang ldan/ /sna tshogs gzugs can skyed pa po/ /mchod cing brjod pa drang srong che/ /rigs gsum 'chang ba pyisang sngags can/ /dam tshig chen po gsang sngags 'dzin/ /gtso bo

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/dkon mchog gsum 'dzin pa/ /theg pa mchog gsum ston pa po/ /don yod zhags pa rnam par rgyal/ /'dzin pa chen po rdo rje zhags/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /khro be'i rgyal po gdong drug 'jig /mig drug lag drug stobs dang ldan/ /keng rus mche ba gcigs pa po/ /ha la ha la gdong brgya pa/ /gshin rje gshed po bgegs kyi rgyal/ /rdo rje shugs can 'jigs byed pa/ /rdo rje grags pa rdo rje'i snying / /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ /rdo rje las skyes rdo rje'i bdag /rdo rje'i snying po mkha' 'dra ba/ /mi g.yo ral pa gcig gis bskyings/ /glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon/ /grags chen hā hā zhesatshosgrogs pa/ /hi hi zhes sgrogs 'jigs par byed/ /gad mo chen po gad rgyangs can/ /rdo rje gad mo cher sgrogs pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje rgyal po bde ba che/ /rdo rje drag po dga' ba che/ /rdo rje hūm̐ ste hūm̐ zhes sgrogs/ /mtshon du rdo rje'i mda' thogs pa/ /rdo rje ral gris ma lus gcod/ /rdo rje kun 'chang rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gcig pu g.yul sel ba/ /rdo rje ral gris ma lus gcod/ /rdo rje kun 'chang rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gcig pu g.yul sel ba/ /rdo rje 'bab pa mig mi bzad/ /skra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa 'bebs pa che/ /mig brgya pa ste rdo rje'i mig /lus 9

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/ni rdo rje'i ba spu can/ /rdo rje'i spu ni gcig pu'i lus/ /sen mo skyes pa rdo rje'i rtse/ /rdo rje'i snying po pags pa mkhregs/ /rdo rje phreng thogs dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /gad rgyangs ha ha nges par sgrogs/ /yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra/ /'jam dbyangs chen po'i sgra che ba/ /'jig rten gsum na sgra gcig pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas sgra sgrogs pa/ /sgra dang ldan pa rnams kyi mchog /yang dag bdag med de bzhin nyid/ /yang dag mtha' ste yi ge med/ /stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ /zab cing rgya che sgra sgrogs pa/ /chos kyi dung ste sgra chen ldan/ /chos kyi ghaṇ+ḍi sgra bo che/ /mi gnas/ mya ngan 'das pa po/ /phyogs bcu chos kyi rnga bo che/ gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid las skyes/ /gzugs rnams thams cad/ snang ba'i dpal/ /gzugs brnyan ma lus 'chang ba po/ /chugs pa med cing che bar grags/ /khams gsum dbang phyug chen po ste/ / 'phags lam shin tu mtho la gnas/ /dar ba chen po chos kyi tog /'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus gcig /gnas bstan rgan po skye dgu'i bdag /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan 'chang ba/ /sdug gu 'jig rten gsum na mjes/ /'jig rten shes legs slob dpon te/ /'jig rten slob dpon 'jigs pa med/ /mgon skyob 'jig rten yid 10

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/gcugs pa/ /skyabs dang skyob pa bla na med/ /nam mkha'i mtha' la longs spyod pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtsho/ /ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs 'byed pa/ /srid pa'i dra ba 'joms pa po/ /nyon mongs ma lus zhi byed pa/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho pha rol phyin/ /ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan du thogs/ /sdug bsngal gsum gyi sdug bsngal zhi/ /gsum sel mtha' yas grol gsum thob/ /sgrib pa kun las nges par grol/ /mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas/ /nyon mongs dri ma kun las 'das/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa po/ /sems can kun gyi klu chen po/ /yon tan thod can rnams kyi thod/ /nyon mongs kun las rnam grol ba/ /nam mkha'i lam la rab gnas pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu chen po 'chang / /khyab bdag rin chen kun gyi mchog /dpag bsam shing chen rgyas pa ste/ /bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog /byed pa sems can kun don byed/ /phan 'dod sems can mnyes gshin pa/ /bzang ngan shes shing dus shes la/ /khyab bdag dam shes dam tshig ldan / /dus shes sems can dbang po shes/ /rnam grol gsum la mkhas pa po/ /yon tan ldan zhing yon tan shes/ /chos shis bkra shis bkra shis 'byung //bkra shis kun gyis bkra shis pa/ /grags pa bkra shis snyan grags 11

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/dge/ /dbyugs 'byin chen po dga' don che/ /dga' chen rol mo chen po ste/ /bkur sti rim gro phun sum tshogs/ / mchog tu dga' ba grags bdag dpal/ /mchog ldan mchog sbyin gtso bo ste/ /skyabasakyi dam pa skyabs su 'os/ /'jig rten dgra ste rab kyi mchog /'jigs pa ma lus sel ba po/ /gtsug phud phud bu lcang lo can/ /ral pa muñdzu cod pan thogs/ /gdong lnga gtsug phud lnga dang ldan/ /zur phud lnga pa me tog thod/ /mgo zlum brtul zhugs chen po pa/ /tshangs par spyod pa brtul zhugs mchog /dka' thub mthar phyin dka' thub che/ /gtsang gnas dam pa go'u tam/ /bram zas tshangs pa tshangs pa shes/ /mya ngan 'das pa tshangs pa thob/ /grol ba'i thar pa rnam grol lus/ /rnam grol zhi ba zhi ba nyid/ /mya ngan 'das zhi mya ngan 'das/ /legs par mya ngan 'das dang nye/ /bde sdug sel bar mthar gyur pa/ /chags bral lus las 'das pa po/ /thub pa med pa dpe med pa/ /mi mngon mi snang gsal byed min / /mi 'gyur kun 'gro khyab pa po/ /phra zhing zag med sa bon bral/ /rdul med rdul bral dri ma med/ /nyes pa spangs pa skyon med pa/ /shin tu sad pa sad pa'i bdag /kun shes kun rig dam pa po/ /rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das/ /ye shes gnyis med tshul 'chang ba/ /rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub/ /dus 12

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/gsum sangs rgya las byed pa/ /sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa/ /ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /ye shes lus can de bzhin gshegs/ /tshig gi dbang phyug smra ba che/ /smra ba'i skyes mchog smra ba'i rgyal/ /smra ba'i dam pa mchog gi gnas/ /smra ba'i seng ge chugs pa med/ /kun tu lta ba mchog tu dga'/ /gzi brjid phreng ba lta na sdug /'od bzangs 'bar ba dpal gyi belā /lag na 'od 'bar snang ba po/ /sman pa che mchog gtso bo ste/ /zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med/ /sman rnams ma lus ljon pa'i shing / /nad do cog gi dgra che ba/ /sdug gi 'jigs rten gsum gyi mchog /dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor can/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar thug par/ /chos kyi rgyal mchan legs par 'dzugs/ /'gro na gdug gcig yangs pa ste/ /byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor can/ /dpal ldan pad+ma gar gyi bdag /khyab bdag chen po rin chen gdugs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku 'chang ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnal 'byor che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa gcig /rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur dpal/ /rin chen kun bdag dbang phyug ste/ /'jig rten dbang phyug kun gyi bdag /rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rje/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs che ba/ /sangs 13

'jam dpal mchan brjed kyi 'grel ma/chan dang sgrub thabs/rgyas kun gyi thugs la gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yang yin/ /rdo rje nyi rma snang ba che/ /rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ /chags bral la sogs chags pa che/ /kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje skyil krung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i chos 'dzin pa/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mjod 'dzin pa/ /rgyal po sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs 'chang / /che ba sangs rgyas rig sngags 'chang / /rdo rje rnon po ral gri che/ /yi ge mchog ste rnam par dag /theg pa chen po sdug bsngal gcod/ /mchon cha chen po rdo rje che/ /rdo rje zab mo dzi na dzika /rdo rje blo gros don bzhin rig /pha rol phyin pa kun rdzogs pa/ /sa rnams kun gyi rgyan dang ldan/ /rnam par dag pa bdag med chos/ /yang dag ye shes zla 'od bzang / /brtson chen sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste/ /rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /rdo rje gdan ni ma lus ldan / /ye shes sku rnams ma lus 'chang / /kun tu bzang po blo gros bzang / /sa yi snying po 'gro ba 'dzin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po che/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang / /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'dzin/ /skye med chos de sna tshogs don/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid 'chang ba/ /shes rab chen po skad cig la/ /chos kun khong du chud 14

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/pa 'chang / /chos kun mngon par rtogs pa ste/ /thub pa blo mchog 'byung po'i mtha'/ /mi g.yo rab tu dang ba'i bdag /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub 'chang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi mngon sum pa/ /ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal/ /'dod pa'i don grub dam pa ste/ /ngan song thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po sems can kun gyi mchog /sems can thams cad rab grol byed/ /nyon mongs g.yul du gcig dpa' ba/ /mi shes dgra yi dregs pa 'joms/ /blo ldan sgeg 'chang dpal dang ldan/ /brtan po mi sdug gzugs 'chang ba/ /lag pa brgya po kun bskyod cing / /gom pa'i stabs kyis gar byed pa/ /dpal ldan lag pa brgyas gang la/ /nam mkha' khyab par gar byed pa/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor bzhi yi khyon/ /rkang pa ya gcig mthil gyis gnon//rkang mtheb sen mo'i khyon gyis kyang / /tshangs pa'i yul sa rtse nas gnon/ /don gcig gnyis med chos kyi don/ /dam pa'i don ni 'jigs pa med/ /rnam rig sna tshogs gzugs don can/ /sems dang rnam shes rgyud dang ldan/ /dngos don ma lus rnams la dga'/ /stong pa nyid dga' 'dod chags blo/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags sogs spangs pa/ /srid gsum dga' ba chen po ste/ /sprin dkar dag pa bzhin du dkar/ /'od bzang ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od/ /nyi ma 'char 15

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes/ /sen mo'i 'od ni shas cher dmar/ /cod pan bzang po mthon ka'i rtse/ /skra mchog mthon ka chen po 'chang / /nor bu chen po 'od chags dpal/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /'jig rten khams brgya kun bskyod pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i stobs chen ldan/ /de nyid dran pa chen po 'chang / /dran pa bzhi po ting 'dzin rgyal/ /byang chub yan lag me tog spos / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan mtsho/ /lam gyi yan lag brgyad tshul rig /yang dag sangs rgyas lam rig pa/ /sems can kun la shas cher chags/ /nam mkha' lta bur chags pa med/ /sems can kun gyi yid la 'jug /sems can kun gyi yid ltar mgyogs/ /sems can kun gyi dbang don shes/ /sems can kun gyi yid 'phrog pa/ /phung po lnga don de nyid shes/ /rnam dag phung po lnga 'chang ba/ /nges 'byung kun gyi mtha' la gnas/ /nges par 'byung ba kun la mkhas/ /nges 'byung kun gyi lam la gnas/ /nges par 'byung ba kun ston pa/ /yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton/ /dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang / /bden bzhi'i chul gyi rnam pa can/ /shes pa brgyad po rtogs pa 'chang / /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/ /rnam par sangs rgyas kun 16

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/rig mchog /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /bye ba dpag med 'gyed pa po/ /skad cig thams cad mngon par rtogs/ /sems kyi skad cig don kun rig /theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don la rtogs pa po/ /theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /nyon mongs khams rnams dag pa'i bdag /las kyi khams rnams zad byed pa/ /chu bo rgya mtsho kun las brgal/ /sbyor ba'i dgon pa las byung ba/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i kun nyon mongs/ /bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs pa/ /snying rje chen po shes rab thabs/ /don yod 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /'du shes kun gyi don spangs sheng / /rnams shes don ni 'gag par byed/ /sems can kun yid yul dang ldan/ /sems can kun gyi yid rig pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /de dag sems dang mthun par 'jug /sems can kun yid tshim par byed/ /sems can kun gyi yid dga' ba/ /grub pa mthar phyin 'khrul pa med/ /nor pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /don gsum the tshom med pa'i blo/ /kun don yon tan gsum gyi bdag /phung po lnga don dus gsum du/ /skad cig thams cad bye brag phyed/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'chang / /lus med lus te lus kyi 17

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/mchog /lus kyi mtha' ni rtogs pa po/ /gzugs rnams sna tshogs kun tu ston/ /nor bu chen po rin chen tog /sangs rgyas kun gyis rtogs bya ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /gsang sngags las byung yi ge med/ /gsang sngags chen ngo/ rigs gsum pa/ /gsang sngags don kun skyed pa po/ /thig le chen po yi ge med/ /stong pa chen po yi ge lnga/ /thig le stong pa yi ge brgya/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/ /yan lag med pa'i rtses las 'das/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo can/ /bsam gtan yan lag kun shes shing / /ting 'dzin rigs dang rgyud rig pa/ /ting 'dzin lus can lus kyi mchog /longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi rgyal/ /sprul ba'i sku ste sku yi mchog /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyud 'chang ba/ /phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /lha dang lha dbang lha yi lha/ /lha yi dbang po lha min bdag /'chi ོ sa ོmed dbang pa lha ya bla/ /'jams byed 'joms byed dbang phyug po/ /srid pa'i dgon pa las brgal ba/ /ston pa gcig pu 'gro ba'i bla/ /'jig rten phyogs bcur rab grags pa/ /chos kyi spyin bdag che ba po/ /byams pa'i go cha chas ba ste/ /snying rje yi ni ya lad bgos/ /spyas rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /nyon mongs mi shes g.yul ngo

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/sel/ /dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul ba/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel bar byed/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams pham byed pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren/ /mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ /rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os/ /bkur 'os rjed par bya ba'i mchog /phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ /'jig rten gsum po gom gcig bgrod/ /mkha' ltar mtha' med rnam par gnon/ /gsum rig gtsang ma dag pa ste/ /mngon shes drug ldan rjes dran drug /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i 'jig rten 'das/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha'/ /shes rab kyis ni de nyid thob/ /bdag rig gzhan rig thams cad pa/ /kun la phan pa'i gang zag mchog /dper bya kun las 'das pa ste/ /shes dang shes bya'i bdag po mchog /gtso bo chos kyis sbyin bdag ste/ /phyag rgya bzhi po'i don ston pa/ /'gro ba'i bsnyen bkur gnas kyi mchog /nges 'byung gsum po bgrod rnams kyi/ /don gyi dam pa rnam dag dpal/ /'jig rten gsum na skal bzang che/ /dpal ldan 'byor pa kun byed pa/ /'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /19

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /oṃ sarba dharmā bhā wa swa bhā wa/ bi shud+dhi baja a ā e aḥ pra kṛ ti pa ri shurnyeḥsarba dharmā ya du ta sarba ta thā ga ta/ dz+nyā na kā ya mañdzu shrī pa ri shud+dhi tā mu pā dā ya ti e aḥ sarba ta thā ga ta hre da ya/ ha ra ha ra/oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ bha ga wān dz+nyā na mur+bhe wā gī shwa ra/ ma hā wā tsa sarba dharmā/ ga ga nā ma la su pa ri shud+dhā/ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥ/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /dga' zhing mgu nas thal mo sbyar/ /mgon po bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de ni mgon po gsang ba'i bdag /lag na rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal/ /sna tshogs gzhan dang lhan cig tu/ /gsang bstod nas ni tshig 'di gsol/ /20

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/mgon po bdag cag yi rang ngo / /legs so legs so legs par gsungs/ /rnam grol 'bras bu 'tshal ba yi/ /'gro ba mgon med rnams dang ni/ /bdag cag yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub thob pa'i don chen mdzad/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i chul bstan pa/ /'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i lam/ /zab cing yangs la rgya che ba/ /don chen 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul 'di ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i don dam pa'i mchan yang dag par brjod pa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/༄༅/ /'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi mchan 'grel rgyud don rab gsal nyi zla'i snang ba/na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig bsdus pa/ /rmad byung blo gros mchog gter ngag gi dbang / /gsang rgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bī ma la/ /gang dang dbyer med khyab bdag bla mar 'dud/ /zab cing rgya che sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud/ /ji bzhin rnam 'grel 'phags bod gzhung kun gyi/ /phul du rab bsngags don gsal sgron me'i ngag /ma nor mchan du dgod la gnang ba stsol/de la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan ji ltar yin pa rtogs par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa dbang po rab 'bring gsum du 'gyur te/ rab la bka' rgyud mdo'i bdag nyid can 'di'i mtshan bshad par bya/ 'bring la gzhung dbu zhabs kyi dbye ba bstan par bya/tha ma la yi ge 'bru re re nas bstan par bya'o/ de la dri ba dang lan gyi tshul du bshad pa/ mtha' sdud kyi tshul du bshad pa dang gsum ni don gnas skabs su sbyar bar bya'o/ /de la dbang po rab mgo smros pas ṭā ba rnams kyi don du rgyud kyi mtshan ba stan pa ni/

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī nā ma saṅga ti/ bod skad du/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mchan yang dag par brjod pa/ zhes pa 'dis bstan te/ de la 'phags pa ni gnyis te/ brjod bya don gyi sgo nas 'phags pa ni/ rje btsun nyid 'khor ba'i mtha' dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' gnyis las 'phags pas/ mtha' gnyis la zhen pa'i sgrib pa med pa yin te/ 'di nyid las/ sgrib pa kun las nges par grol/ mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la gnas/ zhes 'byung ngo / /rjod byed tshig gi sgo nas 'phags pa ni thabs kyi theg pa 'di nyid yin te/ thabs mang ba dang / thabs mkhas pa dang / thabs sla ba dang /thabs myur ba dang bzhis 'phags te/ de yang / don gcig na yang bye brag ni/ thabs mang ba dang mkhas pa dang / de bzhin sla dang myur ba yis/ sngags kyi bstan pa khyad par 'phags/ zhes 'byung ngo / /de la thabs mang ba ni/ gdul bya rnams kyis ji ltar mos pa las ma bzlog par grol ba'i thabs mtha' yas pa ston pa'o/ /de yang / nges 'byung kun gyi lam la gnas/ zhes so/ /nyon mongs ma spangs kyang grol ba'i thabs shes pas thabs mkhas pa'o/ de yang / mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba/ zhes pa'o/ /sgo gsum dka' thub kyis ma gzir bar 'dod pa'i longs spyod la gnas bzhin du grol ba'i thabs ston 23

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/pas thabs sla ba'o/ /de yang / longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi rgyal/zhes so/ /thabs kyi theg pa'i rigs can gyis thams cad gnyis med du rtogs pas tshe 'di nyid la byang chub 'grub pas thabs myur ba'o/ /de la 'jam dpal ni dbye na rnam pa lnga ste/ rang bzhin rgyu'i 'jam dpal dang / sgom pa lam gyi 'jam dpal dang / mthar thug 'bras bu'i 'jam dpal dang / gdul bya las dag pa la snang ba'i 'jam dpal dang / rnam pa'i bdag nyid du snang ba'i 'jam dpal lo/ /de la rang bzhin rgyu'i 'jam dpal ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la de bzhin nyid kyis khyab pa'o/ /de la mtshan rtog gi zug rngu bral ba dang / rtogs na kun gyi dpal du gyur pas de skad ces bya'o/ /sgom pa lam gyi 'jam dpal ni/ bskyed rdzogs sogs lam gyi chos su gyur pa rnams yin te/ de nyid kyi gnas skabs nas rtog pa'i zug rngu rnams ni spangs la shas shig ni spong pa la zhugs pas 'jam la de las bdag dang gzhan gyi don 'byung bas dpal lo/ /mthar thug 'bras bu'i 'jam dpal ni/ sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid la/mchog gi dang po sku gsum 'chang / zhes 'byung ngo / /de la sku gsum ni thun mong gi dbang du byas na/ chos sku skye med nam mkha' lta bu la/longs spyod rdzogs sku rnam par snang mjad sprin lta bu 'byung ba de las/24

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/sprul sku shākya thub pa char lta bus 'gro ba'i don mjad pa'o/ khyad par gyi dbang du byas na/ rig pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ rig pa sna tshogs su 'char ba sprul ba'i sku/ ji ltar snang yang don skye med las ma 'das pa chos kyi sku'o/ /de la ye shes lnga ni/ chos nyid skye 'gag med pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/de nyid gsal la rtog pa med pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de gnyis su dbyer med cing blang dor med pas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid ma 'dres par gsal ba ni so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don rtsol ba med par grub pas ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so/ /de yang 'di nyid las/ khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag ces 'byung ngo / /gdul bya las dag pa la snang ba'i 'jal dpal ni/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin goms pa'i mthus lha sku'i zhal mthong ba'o/ /rnam pa'i bdag nyid du snang ba'i 'jam dpal ni/ sku'i gzugs brnyan du gyur pa ras bal la ri mo bris pa dang / zangs lcags la 'bur du btod pa rnams so/ /gyi zhes pa 'brel ba'i yi ge ste ji skad smos pa'i yon tan rnams dang / yon tan can rje btsun 'jam dpal du 'brel bar ston te/ brgya byin gyi ba phra mo zhes bya ba lta bu'o/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa zhes pa'i mtshan ni 'og nas 25

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/'byung ba'i yon tan gyi chos rnams yin la/ yon tan de dag dang rje btsun nyid ldan la/ ldan pa kho na ltar brjod pa'o/ /tshul ji ltar brjod na gnyis te/ zab pa don gyi sgo nas brjod pa dang / rgya che ba tshig gi sgo nas brjod pa'o/ /don gyi sgo nas brjod pa ni don gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su gsal ba'o/ /tshig gi sgo nas brjod pa la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa'i tshul du brjod pa dang /gsang sngags kyi tshul du brjod pa dang / yon tan gyi tshul du brjod pa'o/ /de la dang po mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa'i chul du brjod pa ni/rang gi sems kyi mtshan nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su ngo shes par byas la mtshan brjod par bya ste/ brjod pa'i sgra de dag byung yang skye 'gag med pa'i ngang las byung la thim yang de nyid du thim ste/mdor na chos kyi rang sgrar shes par bya'o/ /'di nyid las/ gnyis med gnyis su med par ston/ yang dag mtha' la rnam par gnas/zhes 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa mtshan gsang sngags kyi tshul du brjod pa ni/bdag nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal du bsgoms te mtshan brjod pas thugs ka'i māṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod pa dang /sems can gyi don byas/ slar rang gi thugs kar thim/ yang snga ma ltar spro zhing bsdus te/ mchan klog pa ma thon gyi bar du ci rigs su 26

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/bya ba'o/ /de yang 'di nyid las/ gsang sngags chul chen bdag nyid can/ zhes 'byung ngo / /mtshan yon tan gyi tshul du brjod pa rni// rje bcun 'jam dpal nyid la 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs la mtshan brjod par bya ste/'di yang khyod kyi yon tan zhes dmigs pa'o/ /de yang 'di nyid las/de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan mtsho/ zhes 'byung ngo / /de dag kyang bsdu na/ don zab pa dang / tshig rgya che ba gnyis te/ 'di nyid las/zab cing rgya che'i sgra sgrogs pa/ zhes 'byung ngo / /bar chad nye bar zhi ba'i phyir phyag 'tshal ba bstan pa ni/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes smos te phyag na rdo rjes shākya thub pa la zhus nas glegs bam du sdud pa'i dus su klad du yi dam gyi lha la phyag mdzad pa yin te/ 'o na phyag na rdo rje la yang bar chad 'byung ngam zhe na/ ma yin te rjes 'dug gi don du dgongs pa'o/ /de yang 'jam dpal ni gong du bshad zin to/ sku dus gsum du bgres rgud mi mnga' bas gzhon nu ste/ rtag tu da ltar 'byung ba lta bu'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/ /la ni bkar ba'i yi ge ste 'jam dpal nyid la'o/ /phyag 'tshal lo zhes zab pa rtogs pa'i phyag dang / rgya che ba lus ngag yid gsum gus 27

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/pa'i chul gyis phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /da ni dbang po 'bring gi don du dbu zhabs kyi dbye ba bstan pa ni/bshad pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang nas le'u bcu bzhir ston pa las/dang por zhus pa'i le'u bstan pa'i phyir rtsa ba'i rgyud bshad pa'i rjes su/ de nas rtogs pa bdag gi dpal dang thugs rje gzhan gyi dpal gnyis dang ldan pas dpal ldan zab pa don gyi rdo rje ye shes lnga dbyer mi phyed pa 'chang ba'i rtags su rgya che ba lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pas rdo rje 'chang ngo / /tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug la sogs te gdul dka' ba rnams 'dul ba la sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus nas ri rab kyi rtse mor phyag na rdo rje la dbang bskur bas de 'dul byed rnams kyi mchog ces bya'o/ /rang 'jigs pa dang bral zhing gzhan gyi dpung 'joms pas dpa' bo sa 'og gi bdag po ma hā de ba/ sa steng gi bdag po khyab 'jug sa bla'i bdag po tshangs pa gsum ni phyi rol ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi lha gsum yin la de gsum btul bas 'jig rten gsum las rgyal ba'o/ /gsang sngags kyi sdud pa po rdo rje theg pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pas rdo rje dbang phyug gsang ba'i dam tshig dang ldan zhing nang gi nyon mongs pa dang / gdug pa can rnams las rgyal bas gsang ba'i rgyal zhes bya'o/ /skyon gyis ma gos pas pad+ma 28

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/nyon mongs pa med pas dkar po spyan kun tu zlum pas rgyas 'dra'i spyan no/ /pad+ma rgyas pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /rang gi lag gis don gyi rtags su byung ba'i rdo rje mchog /yang dang yang du gsor ba byed pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi 'khor lo yang nas yang du skor cig ces zhu ba 'bul ba'i brda yang yin/ thugs rje rgyun mi chad pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i brda yang yin/ gdug pa can rgyun mi chad par 'dul ba'i brda yang yin/ nang na ye shes rgyun mi chad par mnga' ba'i brda yang yin/ de yis grogs gang dang lhan cig zhus zhe na/ mche ba gcigs/ spyan zlog /smin ma bsdus/ 'bri gu ta gyen du 'greng ba sogs kyi khro gnyer rim par ldan pa la sogs pa khro bo'i tshogs kyi 'khor/ lag na rdo rje yon tan mthu mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu zhus pa'o/ /de dag gis phrin las ci mdzad ce na/gang la'ang mi 'jigs shing bdud dpung 'joms pas dpa' bo gdul dka' btsan thabs kyis 'dul ba po/ /'jigs su rung dang dpa' byed kyi nyams can/ khro bo'i cha byad dang ldan pa'o/ de dag gi phyag mtshan ci zhe na rdo rje'i rtse mo las rdo rje phra mo rab tu 'phro bas gdug pa can 'dul ba/ rang gi lag gis gsor bar byed pa'o/ /'gro ba rnams la snying rje chen po dang ldan pa ni rgya che ba dang / shes 29

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/rab kyis chos rnam par 'byed pa ni zab pa dang / zab cing rgya che ba'i thabs kyis 'gro don byed pa'i mchog go /'gro ba'i don byed pa la dga'/ ston pa mthong bas mgu/ chos bshad pas rjes su yi rang ba'i bsam pa can/ rgyan dang rang bzhin khro bor gnas pas khro bo'i lus kyi gzugs ldan pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis sam 'phrin las rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba'i don mjad pas sangs rgyas 'phrin las byed pa'i mgon/ khro bo de rnams kyis kyang bag med du ma yin te shin tu gus pa'i tshul gyis/ lus btud pa rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /de bzhin nyid du gshegs pa dang / 'gro ba'i don la gshegs shing bdud bzhi bcom/ legs pa'i yon tan drug dang ldan pa che ba'i yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa/ ma rig pa'i sgrib pa sangs shing ye shes rgyas pa ste de lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar bar byas nas ni/ /spyan sngar tsog por 'dug ste 'di skad gsol/ brtan g.yo kun la khyab pas khyab bdag zhes ston pa la bos nas 'khor bdag cag rnams la sman pa dang / bdag cag gi don du bdag la thugs brtse'i phyir/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel bas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste de'i sgo nas mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ci nas bdag gis thob par mdzod/ ces pa ste 30

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/rang don gzhan don dang 'brel ba'o/ /'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pas ni byang chub sems chu rnyog pa lta bur dkrugs shing /de kho na nyid mi shes te glang po che 'dam du tshud pa ltar sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor byings pa yi sems can kun la de las bzlog nas che 'dir sman pa dang / phyi ma bla med byang chub kyi 'bras bu 'thob bya'i phyir yang bshad du gsol/ ston pa gang la zhus she na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'gro ba'i bla ma 'gro ba rnams la chos ston pa po la'o/ /ston pa des mi mkhyen pa mi srid dam zhe na/ don/ rtogs pa las mi 'da' bas dam chig chen po de nyid ji lta ba mkhyen pa gdul bya'i dbang po'i bye brag dang bsam pa gang la gang mos mkhyen pa mchog gis so/ /'o na chos gang zhu zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes sku ni me long ltar thams cad gsal zhing 'char bas me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /gcug tor chen po ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kun gyi spyi bo'i gtsug tu bkur ba'i 'os yin pas ma nyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /tshig gi bdag po ni chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid ma 'dres par mkhyen pa'i sgo nas chos kyi tshig gsungs pa ste so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /ye shes sku ste ni bya ba grub par byed pa'i sku ste de yang ye shes las grub pa'i sku yin pas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes 31

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/so/ /rang byung ba ni skye ba med pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yi/ zhes pa ni rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems te ye shes chen pos mnyam pa nyid la sems la/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don la sems pa'o/ /de'i rtags gzugs skur byung ba la yang de skad ces bya'o/ /tshig dang don gyi sgo nas de'i ming yang dag par brjod pa ni gzhan bas don che bas na yang dag brjod pa'i mchog go/ /mdor na ye shes lnga byang chub sems dang drug ro gcig pa'i chos gcig zhus pa'o/ 'o na ming las don ma zhus sam zhe na/brjod bya'i don zab mo mnyam pa nyid kyi don ston pa dang rnam 'phrul sna tshogs su snang ba'i don ni rgya che zhing / gsang sngags kyi don chen po chos gang dang yang mtshungs pa med pa spros pa'i mtshan ma rab zhi ba/thog mar dge ba thos pa'i shes rab/ bar du dge ba bsam pa'i shes rab dang/ mthar dge ba bsgom pa'i shes rab bo/ /ci'i phyir dge zhe na/ nyon mongs pa rtsad nas 'byin pas dge ba'o/ /de sus gsungs she na/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /zhes pa ni rgyal ba shākya thub pas ri bo bya rkang can du phyag na rdo rje la 'di gsungs pa'i dus su de'i byin rlabs kyis byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams pad+mo can zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin 32

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/gshegs pa pad+mo mchog ces bya bas kyang / 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di gsungs so/ /de bzhin du phyogs lnga por yang gsungs so/ /chos nyid kyi mkha' rnam par dag pa nas kyang sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gis 'khor gyi de bzhin gshegs pa la 'di gsungs so/ /'og min du rnam snang gis byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dang /ri rab kyi rtser sprul sku 'khor los bsgyur ba lta bus kyang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams la 'di gsungs so/ /dga' ldan du lha rnams la rgyal ba byams pas 'di gsungs shing / der ma zad shing dang rde'u dang nam mkha' sogs las kyang 'di'i sgra grag par byung ngo / de yang /sems dpa' mchog gi bstan pa ni/ dbang 'byor ba dang rtogs pa dang / kha dang gzugs ni thams cad dang / nam mkha' las kyang grag par 'gyur/ zhes 'byung ngo / /da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston pa thugs rje can gyis 'di nyid rtsa rgyud khri drug stong par yang lan gcig bshad/ phyis dga' ba spyod pa 'dir yang lan gcig bshad pas/ yang dang yang du gsung ba gang / /rtsa ba'i rgyud chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ /rdo rje 'chang chen gsang sngags 'chang gis kyang / don dpag tu med pa rnams kyi rdo rje'i glu gsungs nas 'khor rnams dga' ba bskyed pa de bzhin du rdo rje 'chang gis glu blangs pa 33

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/gang lags pa bdag cag la yang bshad du gsol zhes pa'o/ /zhus pa'i don de dag bzung bar khas blang ba ni/ mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin par ci nas bdag 'gyur ba'i phyir/ nges par 'byung ba byang chub la thug gi bar du ni/ bdag gi bsam pa the tshom dang brjed pa med par brtan pos bzung ngo zhes khas blang ba'o/ /gzhan don du bshad par khas blang ba ni/ bzung nas ci byed ce na/ sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa ma lus bsal ba dang de'i rgyu mi shes pa ma lus spang ba'i phyir bshad do/ /de yang bsam pa ji ltar mos pa'i khyad par shes par byas te/ bsam pa ji bzhin du sems can rnams la bshad par 'tshal gyi thun mong du ni ma yin no/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pa'i tshul gyis zhus pa ni/gsang dbang lag na rdo rje yis/ de bzhin gshegs la de skad du/gsol nas thal mo sbyar byas te/ lus gus pa'i tshul gyis btud nas ni spyan sngar 'dug ste gdan pad+ma las lus phyed 'phags te gsol ba btab pa'o//da ni lan gsung ba'i le'u bstan pa'i phyir/ ston pa la zhus ma thag pa'i rjes de nas bdud bzhi bcom zhingatsholegs pa'i yon tan drug dang ldan pa rgyal po shākya'i rigs su skyes pas shākya/ sku gsung 34

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/thugs mi dge ba'i las la bsrung mi dgos par rang bzhin gyis thub pas thub pa/ bdag gzhan gyi don thams cad rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid sgrib pa sangs shing ye shes rgyas pa rkang gnyis mi dang lha rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pas mchog go /des tshul ji ltar bshad ce na/ nyid kyi zhal nas ljags dam pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas yin pas bzang ba dang / mi dge ba'i chos mi gsungs pas bzang ba/ de'i mchan nyid ni ring zhing zhal gyi nang du yangs pa yi ljags brkyang bar mdzad de/des las ci mdzad ce na/ ljags kyi rtse mo las 'od zer 'phros te dang po ri bya rkang can gsal bar byas/ de nas 'jig rten gsum po snang bar byed cing / 'od zer gyis bdud bzhi'i dgra rnams 'dul bar byed pa dang / khyad par 'od zer las khro tshogs spros te rgyud bshad pa la bar du gcod pa'i lha'i bu'i bdud btul/ 'od zer phog pas sems can rnams kyi ngan song gsum sogs kyi sdug bsngal sbyang bar byed pa'i 'dzum bstan nas/ zhes pas 'khor la 'dzum pa mdzad pa dang / ljags brkyang ba dang / ljags las 'od zer bkye ba ni chos 'byung ba'i snga ltas gsum yin te/ me 'byung ba'i snga ltas su du ba 'byung ba lta bu'o/ /gsung gang gis zhe na/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i gsung ni snyan pa yis/ 'jig rten gsum 35

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/po kun bkang nas so/ /'ashesar gang la gsungs she na/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pas dbang bskur ba yin te/ de yang / nga ni khro bo gos sngon can/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gsang mtshan tu lag na rdo rje stobs po che zhes btags pa/gsang ba'i dbang thob cing sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba la dbang bas/gsang dbang la ston pas gang du glur blangs de ni slar gsungs pa'o/ /snying rje che dang ldan gyur pas/ 'gro la 'di dang phyi mar phan pa'i don du khyod nga la dri ba la 'di bshad do zhes pa'o/ /ye shes drug ro gcig pa'i lus can 'jam dpal gyi ming nas brjod pa ni don che ba'o/ /ci'i phyir don che zhe na/ bklag pa cam gyis rang rgyud la yod pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dag par byed cing 'phral gyi sdig pa thams cad sel bar byed pas don che ba'o/ /'khor la nyon cig ces par bskul ba'i phyir/ shākya thub pa nga las nyan par brtson pa ni/ legs so dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /lag na rdo rje khyod legs so/ /ci'i phyir legs she na/ 'jam dpal gyi don dri ba'i phyir ro/ /gsang ba'i bdag po zhes sdud pa po la bos nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams la phan par byed pa de'i phyir/ ngas khyod la mtshan yang dag par brjod pa rigs drug gi bdag nyid can legs par bstan par bya yis/ khyod ni rtse 36

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/ gcig pa'i yid kyis nyon cig ces bskul ba'o/ /'o na phyag na rdo rje la yang bskul dgos sam zhe na/ de dgos pa ma yin te phyag na rdo rje la mtshon nas/ phyi rabs kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams la snod kyis ma zin pa dang / brjed pa dang / 'dres pa dang gsum spong la nyon cig ces par gdams pa'o/ /de ltar gsungs pas 'khor rjes su yi rang ba ni bcom ldan bdag cag 'jam dpal gyis chos gnang ba de ni legs so zhes gsol to/ /nyan pa de ma thag pa de nas bcom ldan shākya thub pas gsungs so zhes sbyar ro/ /gsang sngags rigs chen thams cad dang zhes pa 'dis ni rigs bsdus pa la gzigs pa bstan te/gsang sngags 'di man+t+ra zhes pa'i sgras skyob pa la 'jug ste/ mdor na thabs dang shes rab khyad par can la bya'o/ /rigs las byung bas na rigs so/ /rigs 'dzin pas rigs so/ /rigs thams cad kyi bdag por gyur cing rigs thams cad 'dus pas ni rigs chen no/ /'dis bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor gyi theg pa rnams bskyed pa'i gnas su gyur pas kyang de skad ces bya'o/ /'di'i dgos pa ni nyon mongs pa lnga cha mnyam du 'dul ba'i gnyen po ste mdor bstan gyi tshul lo/ /gsang sngags rig sngags 'chang ba'i rigs zhes pa 'dis ni las kyi rigs la gzigs pa bstan te/ gsang sngags ni pho ste thabs 37

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/so/ /rig sngags ni mo ste shes rab bo/ /byed las ni gsang sngags kyis ni log par rtog pa sel lo/ rig sngags kyis ni ma rig pa sel lo/ /de yang / 'da' bar bya ba ma yin la/ dbye bar dka' ba gsang ba nyid/ gsang ste bsgrub phyir sngags pa ni/ gsang sngags zhes bya'i nges par brjod/ ces pa dang / ngag gi rig mchog bsgrub pa dang /dngos grub 'dod pa yod pa ste/ de phyir rig sngags zhes /bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /'chang ba ni 'dzin pa'o/ /'di'i dgos pa ni/gdul bya phrag dog dang le lo shas che ba rnams 'dul ba'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum 'dus pa rnam snang gi rigs la ni rnam par gzigs so/ /'di'i dgos pa ni gti mug shas che ba rnams 'dul ba'o/ /'dis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la gzigs pa bstan to/ /da ni pad+ma'i rigs la gzigs pa bstan te/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis mkhyen te/ de yang gnyis su snang la gnyis su ma zhen pa'i tshul du mkhyen no/ /des na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis ka'i rigs so/ /'di'i dgos pa ni 'dod chags shas che ba rnams 'dul bar byed do/ /rdo rje'i rigs la gzigs pa bstan pa ni/'jig rten gyi chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med par me long gi 38

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/gzugs brnyan ltar rtogs pas/ 'jig rten snang bar byed pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pas rigs chen dang / 'di'i dgos pa zhe sdang shas che ba rnams 'dul bar byed do/ /da ni rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i rigs bstan te/ phyag rgya la spyir du ma yod kyang 'dir rgyas 'debs pa'i phyir phyag rgya ste/ chos thams cad skye ba med pas rgyas 'debs pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i rigs mchog dang / 'di'i dgos pa ni spros pa'i mtshan ma thams cad 'joms par byed rdo// /rin chen rigs la gzigs pa bstan pa ni/rin chen 'byung ldan ni sangs rgyas kyi che ba'i yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i rigs yin pas/ rigs chen yon tan gyis mtho bar byas pas gtsug tor cher gzigs nas zhes pa ming gi rnam grangs te gzigs zhes bya/ ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug ces bya'o/ /de yang tshul ji ltar gzigs na/ ye shes kyi spyan gyis zab pa ji lta ba'i don la gzigs pa dang / thugs rje'i spyan gyis rgya che ba ji snyed pa la gzigs pa'o/ /yang gsum ste/ spang bya nyon mongs pa dang / de spong ba'i gnyen po lha'i rigs dang / lha'i rtog pa zlog par byed pa ye shes la gzigs pa rnams su yang sbyar ro/ /da ni sgyu 'phrul drwa ba man ngag gi le'u bstan pa'i phyir thams 39

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/cad la bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsung gi mnga' bdag yin pas tshig gi bdag pos rigs la gzigs pa thugs la rtogs nas rigs drug gi bdag nyid tsheg bar bdun pa nyid du tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra twek+ṣa na la sogs pa ye shes sems dpa' drug gi gsang sngags rgyal po drug dang ldan zhing gzung 'dzin gnyis su med par ye shes kyi sku'i bdag nyid du 'byung ba dang / rig pa rang gsal ba de yang skye med kyi rang bzhin du gnas pas mi skye'i chos can 'bras bu'i mchog 'di gsungs pa/ 'bras bu la drod pa bskyed pa'i phyir 'bras bu'i sa bstan pa ni/ a ā i sī u mū e i o au oṃ āḥ de yang dbyangs bcu gnyis so/ /'bras bu'i sa bcu gnyis dang sbyar te gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa bcu gnyis la mtho dman dang rim pa yod pa ma yin te/ ye shes gcig la yon tan gyi bye brag bcu gnyis su bstan pa'o/ /de yang sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis ma rig pa bcom nas shes bya gsal bar snang ba dang / nyon mongs pa ma spangs par ye shes su gsal ba dang / mtha' dang dbus med pa dang / mi 'gyur zhing dbyer mi phyed pa dang / sems can gyi dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba dang / 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang skyon gyis ma gos pa dang / rtsol ba med/ par gzhan don 'grub pa dang /40

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/yang dag par dpes mtshon pa dang bral ba dang / phyogs 'dra tsam— gyis mtshon du btub pa dang / rig pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang / shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa dang / so so rang rig pa gnyis su mkhyen pa'o/ /de rnams su sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad 'dus par shes par bya'o/ de yang 'di skad du/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ kun tu 'od kyi sa chen po/ de ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'bor 'dra/ bdud rtsi 'od ni gnyis pa ste/ shin tu 'od gsal zla ba 'dra/ nam mkha' 'od ni gsum pa ste/ nam mkha' ji bzhin rab tu gnas/ rdo rje 'od ni bzhi ba ste/ sa de nyid ni yid dga' ba'o/ /lnga pa rin chen 'od ces pa/ dbang bskur ba la rab tu gnas/ pad+ma'i 'od ni drug pa ste/ pad+ma bzhin du rab tu gyes/ bdun pa las kyi 'od ces bya/ sangs rgyas phrin las byed par 'dod/brgyad pa dpe med ces pa ste/ don la dpe dang mnyam pa min/ dpe ldan zhes pa dgu pa yin/ thams cad dpe ni so sor 'bigs/ bcu pa shes rab 'od ces pa/ sangs rgyas sa ni bla na med/ bcu gcig thams cad mkhyen pa nyid/ sa chen rab tu 'od gsal ba/ bcu gnyis so sor rang rig pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes rab tu rdzogs/ zhes 'byung bas gsal 31/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi 41

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/bdag nyid du 'jam dpal nyid bstan pa'i phyir/ sbi to hrī di thugs kar gnas pa'o/ /dz+nyā na murti ye shes kyi sku'o/ /ra haṃ bhurnyo dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas so/ /bhud+dhā nai bdag nyid sangs rgyas yin no/ /s+t+ya dh+wa bar+bhe rna dus gsum du bzhugs pa'o/ /mtha' bsdus pas ni dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi sku'i bdag nyid thugs la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas yin zhes pa'o/ /de la shes rab ye shes kyi zhalar lo bsgom pa bstan pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra tīyi rdo rje rnon po/ duḥkhats+tsha da sdug bsngal gcod pa'o/ /pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta ye ye shes kyi gcug tor ro/ /dz+nyā na kā ya ye shes kyi sku can no/ /wā gī shwa ra ngag gi dbang phyug a ra pa tsa na ya te na maḥ skye ba med pa'i shes rab chags pa med pa'i spyod yul zhes pa'o/ /de dag ni pad+ma dang rdo rje dang de bzhin gshegs pa dang / las dang rin po che dang / byang sems rdo rje'i rigs te go rim bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /bsgom zhing sngags bzlas pa'i tshe na ni bdag nyid rje btsun du bsgoms pa'i thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs drug mu khyud ldan pa la sngags drug po bkod la spro bsdu bya zhing bzlas pas/ mtshan brjod 'don pa'i dus su ni/ 'di rnams ming gi gtso bo rnams kyi sgo nas bstod pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /da ni rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi sgo nas 'jam dpal ye shes 42

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/sems dpa'i le'u bstan pa ni/ mtshan rgyas par bshad pa/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos skye ba med pa bsgoms pa las 'byung bas a las byung zhes bya'o/ /'o na yi ge a gcig pu las 'byung ba ci zhe na/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchogaci'i phyir mchog yin zhe na/ chos kyi don chen po ston pa'i yi ge dam pa yin no/ /ci'i phyir dam pa yin zhe na/ yi ge'i skye gnas lce rkan sogs la rag ma las par khong nas rang byung du 'byung ba don chen po skye ba med pa'i don ston pas yi ge rnams kyi dam pa'o/ /de nyid la brjod du med par gnas pas tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste zhes bya'o/ /brjod pa'i sgra thams cad kyi rgyu'i gtso bor gyur te ngag thams cad la 'jug par byed pas/ brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /tshig kun rab tu gsal bar byed/ /'o na nyon mongs pa ji ltar spangs zhe na/mchod pa ni lha mnyes par byed pa'i phyir na mchod pa ste/ 'dir nyon mongs pa ma spangs par ye shes su grub pa dgos pa mthun te rang gis mchod pa'o/ /chen po'i sgra ni dug sel ba'i sngags la dug sngags zer ba ltar mi mthun pa'i phyogs 'joms pas chen po'o/ /'di ni 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar ro/ /mchod pa chen po chos mnyam pa nyid la ngang gis chags pas 'dod chags che/ des log pa'i 43

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/'dod chags sel bar byed cing zag med kyi dga' ba skyed par byed pas sems can thams cad dga' bar byed pa'o/ /mchod pa chen po rnam par rtog pa 'joms pa'i zhe sdang che/ zhe sdang rang ga ma 'joms pas nyon mongs kun gyi dgra che ba/ /mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /gti mug blo ste zhes pa chos tha dad du byed pa med pa'i don gyi gti mug dang ldan pas gti mug rang ga ma sel ba'o/ /mchod pa chen po nyon mongs pa skyer mi ster bas khro ba che/ khro ba chen po des khong khro rang ga ma 'joms pas dgra che ba'o/ /mchod pa chen po zag med kyi bde ba la chags pa che/ ser sna'i chags pa rang ga ma thams cad sel bar byed pa'o/ /de dag la man ngag tu sbyar na/ nyon mongs pa de dag la zhen pa'i gdul bya la de dag ma spangs par rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa'i thabs kyis grol bar byed pas spyod mthun grol ba'i mchod pa/ nyon mongs pa ye shes lngar gnas gyur pas gnas gyur ye she sa kyi mchod pa/ nyon mongs pa lnga las grol bas rigs lnga'i sku phyag rgya chen po thob pas grol mthar phyag rgya'i mchod pa/ nyon mongs pa la brtags na ngo bo grub pa med de chos nyid du gnas pas rang bzhin dag pa'i mchod pa'o/ /sems can thar pa 'dod pa chen po'i blo yod pa thar pa'i bde ba chen po skyed par byed cing chos bstan pas 44

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/dga' ba chen po bskyed la don rtogs pas mgu ba chen po'i sbyin pa'o/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa'i gzugs che ba gdos po can gyi lus lta bur sprul te/ de yang ye shes las grub pa yin pas lus kyang che ba ste/ nang na ye shes gsal ba'i rtags su sku gzi mdangs dang ldan pas kha dog che zhing gzhan zil gyis gnon pas lus bong che ba'o/ /grags pa chen po yod pas ming yang che zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs rgyas pas rgya che ba'o/ /'dir zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis su med pa dang / no pi ka mtha' dag 'byung bas dkyil 'khor chen po kun la khyab pa dang gang yang bkag pa med pas yangs pa yin/ de la ye shes kyi khyad par ni shes rab kyi mtshon chen 'chang bas nyon mongs pa 'joms te/ dper na nyon mongs pa glang po che spyon pa la ye shes lcags kyus 'dul ba lta bu dang ldan pas/ nyon mongs chen po'i lcags kyu mchog /de yang khams gsum du grags pa khyad par can yod pas grags chen snyan grags chen po ste/ nang du ye shes gsal ba'i rtags su phyir 'od zer gsal bas bskor ba ni snang ba chen po gsal ba che'o/ /'gro ba la tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen po 'chang bas sgyu 'phrul chen po 'gro ba'i don sgrub par mdzad pa thugs rjes 'gro ba'i 45

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/don la dga' zhing / shes rab kyis gnyis med kyi don la dag/'a bas/sgyu 'phrul chen po'i dga' bas dga' zhes bya'o/ /sgyu 'phrul chen po'i mig 'phrul can ni med pa 'phrul zhing yod pa bsgyur ba dang 'dra ste don zab mo ma rtogs pa rnams la mig 'phrul bstan nas dngos 'jin zlog pa'o/ /des thun mong gi lam ji lta bu ston zhe na/ 'bar gsum yongs su dag pa gtong bas sbyin bdag chen po gtso bo ste/nyes byas mi 'byung bas chul khrims chen po 'chang ba'i mchog /mchan mas mi 'a(grags pas bzod chen 'chang ba brtan pa po/ /rtog pas ma gos pas brtson 'grus chen po brtul ba yin la/ g.yeng ba nyid la rdo rjer bshad/ ces pa lta bu'o/ /de yang don gyi sgo nas bag chags thams cad 'joms pas drag po chen po/ rtags kyi sgo nas gdug pa 'dul bar byed pa'i drag po'i gzugs su sprul pas drag shul che/des gang 'jigs par byed na khyab 'jug dang ma hā de ba la sogs pa 'jigs chen rnams rje bcun gyis 'jigs par byed pas na 'jigs par byed pa po'o/ /khyad par gyi lam gyi tshul gang zhe na/ gdul bya'i mgon skyabs mdzad pa'i mgon po sku gsung thugs kyi lha'i rigs las mchog tu gyur pas rigs mchog chen po ste/ 'gro ba la dam pa'i chos nye bar ston pas bla ma/ thabs dang shes rab khyad par can ston 46

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/pas gsang sngags che ba'i mchog go/ /don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ sa dang pha rol phyin pa las/ sngags kyi bstan pa khyad par 'phags/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de yang theg pa chen po ni shes rab dang snying rje'i khyad par du byas pa'o/ /skal ba can de la gzud pa'i phyir rang nyid kyang theg pa chen po'i tshul la gnas par ston pa'o/ /sna tshogs ston par thabs che ba yin la/ thabs dang shes rab ni khyab che ste lam dang 'bras bus bsdus pa yongs la gnas so/ /'o na rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo ji lta bus don mdzad ce na/ stod nas me 'bar smad nas chu 'brub pa dang / gcig du mar byed/ du ma gcig tu byed/ stong gsum phyag rgyar ye nga ba/ phyag rgya stong gsum du sprul pa la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul chen po/ tshur mi brdzi ba dang gzhan phar 'joms pas stobs dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba'i don byed pa la yid ltar mgyogs pa'i shugs dang ldan pas shugs chen mgyogs pa chen po ste/ de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul chen po de nyid nyan rang dang 'jig rten dang byang sems rnams la cher grags pa'o/ /ye shes kyi stobs chen pos pha rol bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa po zhes bya'o/ /yang nas yang du 'gro ba drug tu skye bas srid pa ri bo ltar gzhom dka' bas ri bo chen po gnyis med 47

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/rtogs pas 'joms par byed pa'o/ /de yi mtshan nyid mi 'gyur bas mkhregs shing / stong pa nyid rdo rje ltar dbyer mi phyed pas rdo rje chen po 'chang zhes bya'o/ /mi phyed mi chod mi shigs pa'i stong par dgra med pas bsam gtan chen po'i ting 'dzin gnas/ gnyis med rtogs pas shes rab chen po'i lus 'chang ba/ bdud kyi dpung 'joms pas stobs po che la bdag dang gzhan grol bar byed pa'i thabs sna tshogs mnga' bas thabs che ba/ bdag dang gzhan grol bar byed pa'i smon lam mnga' bas smon lam dang / ye shes rgya mtsho ste ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' ba/ rgya che ba dang snang la zhen pa med pa rgya mtsho dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang rje bcun ldan la gzhan la yang ston par mdzad do/ 'gro ba la bu gcig pa'i ma bzhin du byams pa de nyid la ma zhen pas chen po'i rang bzhin ris su ma chad pa dang res 'jog med pas dpag tu med pa'o/ /'gro ba la snying rje rgyun mi chad pas chen po de nyid la ma zhen pas blo yi mchog go/ /thabs dang shes rab kyi khyad par ci zhe na/ chos rab tu rnam par phye nas gnyis med rtogs pa'i shes rab chen po des/ 'gro ba'i don byed pa'i blo gros chen po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas thabs kyi bya ba la mkhas pa chen po gdul bya'i bsam pa dang sbyar nas/ gang la ji ltar 48

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/'dul ba'i thabs theg pa chen po 'di'i tshul gyi 'bor 'das dbyer med du ston pas pha rol tu phyin pa las mchog tu gyur to/ /da ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi sgo nas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan bstan pa'i phyir/ sgrib pa sangs shing ye shes rgyas pas gdul bya la rnam par snang ba sna tshogs su mdzad la gzhan don mdzad pas che ba'o/ /sku gsung thugs mi dge ba'i las la bsrung mi dgos par rang gis thub pas thub pa chen po de yang dus rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pas thub chen ldan no/ /gzhan la bstan pa ma yin pas gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu ston pa dang /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srog bskul bas na sngags tshul chen ni lam ste de las sangs rgyas byung ba'o/ /rje btsun nyid gsang sngags kyi ngo bo nyid du bzhugs pas gsang sngags tshul chen bdag nyid can/ thun mong gi lam gang zhe na pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la dbang thob pa ste/ gzhan de la gzud pa'i phyir rang yang pha rol phyin pa bcu la gnas pa'i tshul ston pa dang / de rnams la ma zhen pas pha rol phyin bcu dag pa ste/ pha rol phyin pa bcu po de yi tshul la mkhas pa'o/ /mgon po 'jam dpal ni sa bcu la dbang bsgyur bas sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste/ gzhan de la gzud pa'i phyir sa bcu la ni 49

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/gnas pa'i tshul ston pa po/ der yang ma zad de che ba'i yon tan du mar snang ba'i phyir/ shes pa bcu bo rang bzhin med par shes nga/sa rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can zhes bya ste/ shes pa bcu ni/ chos shes pa/ rjes su 'gro ba shes pa/ pha rol gyi sems shes pa/ sdug bsngal shes pa/ kun 'byung shes pa/ 'gog pa shes pa/ lam shes pa/zad pa shes pa/ mi skye ba shes pa'o/ /de rnams gzhan la ston pas shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po zhes bya'o/ /rnam pa bcu bo ni 'khor ba'i chos phung po lnga/ nyon mongs pa lnga te 'khor ba'i chos thams cad bsdus na der 'dus shing de dag rnam par dag pas don bcu ste rigs lnga ye shes lnga'o/ /de bcu ni don du gnyer bar bya ba'i 'os yin pas don zhes bya'o/ /thub pa ni rgyal ba rnams te/ de rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pas thub dbang / gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i stobs bcu de yang thugs rje chen pos kun la khyab pa'i bdag nyid du bzhugs pa'o// thugs rjes khyab pa tsam ma yin te gdul bya kun gyi don ni ma lus par ji ltar 'chams par byed pa'o/ /tshe/ sems/ yo byad/ las/ skye ba/ rdzu 'phrul/ mos pa/ smon lam/ye shes/ chos te dbang rnam pa bcu yi dbang dang ldan pa'i che ba po/de ltar na mtshan ma can gyi skyon du mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ chos nyid la 50

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/thog ma dang mtha' ma/ med pa la brtags pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas spros pa med pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur ba med pas de bzhin nyid bdag gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma med pas dag pa'i bdag go /de ltar na gzhan gyi don la ji ltar 'jug ce na/ gzhan mi bslu bar don dang mthun par bden par smra zhing dam bcas pa'i tshig gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'o/ /chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam lta bu yin no zhes ji skad smras pa de bzhin du rang yang spyod par byed do/ /gnyis su med par gzigs pa dang rang gis ji ltar gzigs pa'i gnyis su med don ston par mjad pa'o/ /des mi mthun pa'i phyogs zil gyis gnon par bstan pa ni/ yang dag pa'i mtha' gnyis med la rnam par gnas pas/ bdag dang bdag gir mngon zhen med pa'i chos kyi seng ge'i sgra 'jigs pa med par sgrog pa dang ldan pas lta ba log pa bdag tu rtogs cing / nang ba la smod pa'i mu stegs kyi ri dwags ngan pa rnams 'jigs shing skrag par byed cing / dus kun tu 'gro ba'i don yod pa ste skyes bu chen po'i stobs ltar snang nas don mdzad do/ /de yang 'gro ba'i don la de ka bzhin du gshegs pa'i tshul dper na yid ltar mgyogs pa'o/ /de la sku'i yon tan ji ltar snang na/ yon tan gyi bgo skal gyis ma pham pas rgyal ba/ rnam par rtog pa las rgyal bas dgra 51

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/rgyal bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal ba ste/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po ltar sprul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor pas 'gro ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba dang / dkyil 'bor gyi gtso bo mdzad pas kyang 'khor los bsgyur ba ste gzhan gyi dpung 'joms pas stobs po che'o/ /nyan thos kyi tshogs kyi slob dpon/ rang rgyal 'dren pas tshogs kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rje/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshogs kyi bdag po rnams la dbang bsgyur ba'i mthu dang ldan pa'o/ /der yang ma zad de gzung 'dzin 'joms pa'i mthu chen po mnga' bas shin tu gces pa'i chos gnyis su med pa gces par 'dzin pa ste/ des na gsang sngags kyi chul chen po ni lam la bgrod du med pas gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog ste gzhan gyis bkri mi dgos pa'o/ /de la gsung gi yon tan ji lta bu 'byung zhe na/ don so so yang dag par rig pas tshig rje/ nges pa'i chig so so yang dag par rig pas tshig bdag chos so so yang dag par rig pas smra mkhas pa/ spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pas chig la dbang ba/ sgra skad sna tshogs kyi don mdzad pas tshig mtha' yas so /mi bslu ba'i chos gsungs pas tshig bden pa dang bden par smra ba bden pa gnyis dang / bden pa bzhi ni phye nas kyang ston pa po nges 52

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/par 'byung ba'i chos su ji ltar snang zhe na/ spyir bzod pa thob nas ngan song du mi ldog sa dang po thob nas 'khor bar mi ldog brgyad pa non nas theg dman du mi ldog ste/ de phyin chad rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa 'bor bar phyir mi 'ong ngo / /'gro ba'i don du sprul pa ni ma gtogs so/ /'dren pa rang rgyal ne tso ltar tshogs spyod/gcig pur gnas pa bse ru'i chul ni bse ru lta bu'o/ /rje btsun de dag tu sprul pa'o/ /der ma zad theg pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas gang la gang gis 'dul ba dang khams gsum las nges par 'byung ba'i lam sna tshogs ston par mdzad pas gdul bya rnams nges par 'byung ba la 'god pa'o/ /'byung ba chen po lngar snang nas kyang don mdzad de/ de dag gi rgyu ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yin pas rgyu gcig po zhes bya'o/ /dge ba lam du slong zhing nyon mongs pa'i dgra bcom pa srid par skye ba'i zag pa zad pa/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang bral bas spyod yul gyis mi gos te mig la sogs pa'i dbang po yul lnga la mi chags pas thul ba'o/ /zag pa med pa'i bde ba rnyed pas srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs pa med pa thob pa'o de 'chad pa po'i chul ci 'dra zhe na/ bsil ba chu lta bur gyur pa'i chos nyid kyis nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba sel zhing / glo bur gyi rnam par 53

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/rtog pa dri ma chu'i rnyog pa lta bu med pa'o/ /mig dang 'dra ba'i lta ba rig pa dang ni rkang pa dang 'dra ba'i spyod par zung 'brel du ldan pas/'ashesar ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral bas bde bar gshegs pa/ sems can gyi las 'phro dang mos pa dang / snod du rung mi rung dang 'dul ba'i dus la bab ma bab mkhyen pas/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal las khyad par du 'phags pas 'jig rten rig pa'i mchog go /mngon sum du snang ba 'di sgyu ma lta bur mkhyen pas phyi yul la bdag gir mi 'dzin nang sems la ngar mi 'dzin te/ rang don dang gzhan don gyi dbang gis bden pa gnyis kyi tshul la gnas par byed do/ /'o na 'khor bar mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ 'khor ba'i pha rol mthar son pa ste/bya ba byas pas stobs dang ldan pa 'dam nas 'thon pa ltar skam sar gnas pa'o/ de'i rgyu shes pa 'ba' zhig nges gsal ba/ zhes gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i ye shes las gzugs sku gnyis 'byung ba'o/ /des bstan pa'i chos gang zhe na/ shes rab mtshon cha lta bus nyon mongs pa rnam par 'joms pa/ dam pa'i chos chos kyi rgyal po lta bu thugs la gsal bar ldan pas/ 'jig rten pa la ye shes snang bar byed pa'i bdag nyid thar pa mchog la sbyor ba'o/ /des gzhan don 'byung ba'i chul ni/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong la rje btsun 54

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/ nyid dbang bsgyur bas chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal ba'o/ /des gdul bya rnams nyon mongs pa las rgyal bar byas nas phyin ci ma log par legs pa'i lam ji ltar 'tshams par bstan te/ sems can gyi don dang bsam pa 'grub par byed pas/ legs pa'i lam ni ston pa po/ don 'grub bsam pa 'grub pa ste/ zhes bya'o/ /'o na rje btsun nyid rtog bcas su mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ gzhan don mdzad kyang kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs pa ste yang dag pa'i ye shes log rtog dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /rnam par mi rtog kyang dbyings las yon tan mi zad pa 'byung ste/ yon tan gyi 'byung khungs chos kyi dbyings dam pa la yon tan zad mi shes pa ldan pa'o/ /des tshogs ji ltar rdzogs she na/ rje btsun nyid ye nas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ldan pa yin yang gzhan de la gzhug pa'i phyir nyid kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i tshul ston pa'o/ /ye shes kyi tshogs dang yang ldan te/de yang nyan rang gi ye shes las kyang byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes yon tan gyi 'byung gnas khyad par che ste/ de las kyang khyad par du gyur pa sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang ldan pa/ yod pa ji snyed pa'i chos can med pa ji lta ba'i chos nyid shes pa'o/ /de ltar tshogs gnyis rdzogs pas tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po zhes tshogs las 55

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/'byung bar bstan pa'o/ /tshogs bsags pa las sangs rgyas kyi sku ji ltar 'byung zhe na/ don dam pa chos kyi sku mi 'gyur ba de rnam rtog gi dgra las rgyal bas rtag pa kun rgyal thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel bas rnal 'byor can te/ 'di skad du/ thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/ rnal 'byor zhes su brjod pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i snying po la rnam par rtog pas mi g.yo bas bsam gtan sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba rnams kyis bsam par bya ba'i 'os yin pas bsam bya gnyis med rtogs pas blo ldan mchog go/ /chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid ma 'dres par so sor rang gis rig pa de la ma zhen pa ni mi g.yo ba'o/ /de lta bu ni sku thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pas mchog gi sku'i bye brag gzhan 'byung ba la dang po de thob dgos pas/ dang po sku gsum 'chang ba ni de'i yon tan gyi khyad par sku gsum du snang ba'o/ /de la sku dang ye shes kyi bye brag ji ltar 'byung zhe na/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can ni sku gsum mi 'gyur rdo rje mngon par byang chub ste lnga'o/ /khyab bdag ni chos kyi dbyings kyis kun la khyab pa ste/ ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid rnam snang la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga bdag ye shes lnga las sangs rgyas lngas brgyan pa'i cod paṇa can zhes bya'o/ /spyan lnga ni sha'i spyan/56

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/lha'i spyan/ shes rab kyi spyan/ chos kyi spyan/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan te de rnams la thogs pa med cing chags pa med pa 'chang ba'o sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa po/ /zhes pa byang chub kyi sems de kho na nyid rtogs nas sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum du 'gyur zhing / sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi sras yin pas sangs rgyas sras po/ /snying rje dang shes rab chen pos sangs rgyas kyi rigs 'dzin cing mdzad pa sgrub pas dam pa'i mchog ces bya ste/ de yang gnas skabs su rje btsun nyid byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs su bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pas de skad ces bya'o/ /des mdzad pa ci mdzad ce na/ de kho na nyid shes pas srid pa las 'byung ste 'khor bar skye ba'i gnas med do/ /chos kyi sku rtogs pa las ye shes 'byung ba ste des srid pa 'byung ba'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa sel lo/ /gang gis sel na ye shes drug ro gcig pas gcig pu gzhan gyis mi shigs mi phyed pas sra mkhregs rdo rje'i bdag nyid des sel lo/ /dus nam sel na skyes ma thag tu sel nas 'gro ba'i bdag nyid chen por 'gyur ba'o/ /'gro ba'i bdag nyid chen po de la ye shes lnga yi chul gyis gzhan gyi ma rig pa ji ltar sel na/chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' dang 'dra ba las byung ba rang byung ba ste 57

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /shes rab dam pa rtogs te gsal la rtog pa med pa'i ye shes kyi me bo che yi mes rtswa sbur sreg pa ltar sgrib pa'i tshogs 'joms pa me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /'od/ chen po 'bar bas gdul bya la che ba'i yon tan sna tshogs rnam par snang bar byed pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la skar ma'i tshogs gsal ba ltar ye shes kyi snang ba lam me gsal ba ni chos rnam/sa kyi mchan nyid ma 'dres pa rtogs pa so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes 'gro ba'i ma rig pa'i mun pa sel bas mar me lta bu ye shes snang ba gsal ba'i sgron me chen po'o/ /ga/zhan zil gyis gnon pa'i gzi brjid kyi phung po chen po mnga' zhing nang na ye shes gsal ba'i rtags su phyi rol gyi 'od kha dog lnga gsal ba'o/ /sngags kyi mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rig sngags yin la/ de'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po shes rab dang ye shes/ gsang sngags kyi rgyal po thabs dang shes rab khyad par can yin pas/ skal ba ldan pa la de gnyis kyi sgo nas don chen byed pa'o/ /de ni rmad du byung ba'i chos yin pas gtsug tor ltar kun gyis spyi gtsug tu bkur bar 'os pa'i phyir gtsug tor chen po rmad byung gtsug de tsam du ma zad 'phrul pa sna 58

'jam dpapa mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/tshogs su 'byung ba'i zad pa rang gi don nam mkha'i bdag po'i nam mkha'i bdag nyid nam mkha' lta bu las rgya che ba gzhan gyi don sna tshogs ston pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid dngos mchog ni sku drug/ po ro gcig pa'o/ /des 'gro ba'i don la gzigs te 'gro kun ji ltar dga' ba'i gzugs sna tshogs mdzad tshul mkhyen pa'i mig dang ldan pa ste// mdor na byang chub kyi sems sna tshogs pa'i gzugs can du sprul nas gdul bya la yon tan skyed pa'o/ /de nyid don dang ldan pas gzhan gyis bkur ba'i 'os su gyur pa'i phyir/ lha da/nga bcas pas mchod cing brjod pa drang srong chen po/ sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum 'chang ba thabs shes khyad par can 'chang ba gsang sngags can/ don las mi 'da' bas dam chig chen po gsang sngags kyi sgo nas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ /rtsa ba byang chub sems te chos thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pas/ gtso bo dkon mchog gsum gyi tshul 'jin cing gzhan la'ang 'dzin du 'jug par mjad pa/ de yang rgya che ba'i dkon mchog ni spyi dang mthun/ zab pa'i dbang du byas nas/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis su med pas sangs rgyas dkon mchogade'i don rtogs pas chos dkon mchog rjes su sgrub pas ni dge 'dun dkon mchog go/ /chos kyi sgo mo ji snyed pa yang theg pa gsum 59

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/du 'dus te gdul bya rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ theg pa mchog gsum gdul bya'i blo dang sbyar nas gang mos pa la ston pa po ste 'gro ba'i don yod par mdzad pa ni zhags pa dang 'dra bas/ gdul bya rjes su bzung nas 'khor ba las rnam par rgyal bar byed do/ /thugs rje'i zhags pas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa chen po chos sku rdo rje lta bu rtogs pa las byung bas rdo rje zhags pa zhes bya'o/ /thugs rjes gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pas rdo rje lcags kyu dang 'dra/ nyon mongs nga/ rnams 'ching bas zhags pa dang 'dra zhing de nyid la'ang ma zhen pas che zhes bya'o/ /da ni me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi sgo nas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan bstan pa'i phyir 'dir khro bo gshin rje'i ming bstan te/ de yang rdo rje'i rigs yin pas rdo rje shin tu 'jigs par byed pa'i cha byad du bstan nas ma hā de ba la sogs pa dang las kyi gshin rje rnams zhi bas mi 'dul ba de dag 'jigs shing skrag par byed pas 'dul ba'o/ /da ni yon tan rtags kyi phyag rgya bstan te khro bo ni gsod pa dang skrod pa la sogs pa drag po'i cha byad du ston pa ste/ de yang / gsod dang skrod dang drag por ston/ 'di ni khro bo'i don du brjod/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /des nang du me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis nyon mongs pa zhe sdang 60

'jam dang/la mchan brjo da kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/la sogs pa bcom pa'i rtags so/ /de ni khro bo rnams kyi nang na gtso bor gyur nga/sa khro bo'i rgyal po rigs drug nga/nga ldan pa'i rtags su gdong drug 'jigs/ ye shes drug dang ldan pa'i rtags su mig drugaphar phyin drug dang ldan pa'i rtags su lag drug gdug pa 'joms par byed pa'i stobs dang ldan pa mi mgo skam rlon gyis brgyan pas/keng rus nges nga/ra 'byed pa'i shes rab rnon pos nyon mongs pa 'joms shing gdug pa can 'dul ba'i rtags su mche ba gtsigs pa po/ 'dis ni 'jigs byed/ chen po'i rgyan bstan/ te ha la ha la dug ste mthong reg kha chu dang kha'i rlangs nga/ ste dug bzhi dang lngan pa'i sbrul gyis lus dang yan lag brgyan pas sbrusnyel gdug pa'i gdengs ka'i gdong brgya dang ldan/ pa/ 'dis sku'i 'phrin las bstan te/ 'di las kyi gshin rje rnams 'dul ba'i gshed po byi na ya ka dang / tshogs bdag glang sna la sogs pa 'dul bar byed/ pas bgegs kyi rgyal po'o/ /rdo rje ltar phrin las thogs pa med par mdzad pa'i rdo rje shugs can te/ de'i sgo nas/ gdug pa can rnams 'jigs shing skrag par byed pa'o/ /rdo rje'i grags pa'i khyad par ci tsam zhe na/ chos thams cad rdo rje ltar da/byer mi phyed cing 'jig rten gsum du grags pa/ chos thams cad kyi ‘spruphro gzhir gyur pas sam thugs rdo rje'i rigs yin 61

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/pas kyang rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam par 'phrul zhing rdo rje'i sku de yang nang du che ba'i yon tan thams cad kyis gang ba'i rtags su gsus khyim che bas gsus po che'o/ /de'i rgyu ci zhe na/ rgyu ni chos rdo rje lta bu rtogs pa las skyes te rigs thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur pas lngo rnge'i bdag po'o/ /de'i dpe ni rdo rje'i snying po ni dngos po med pa / —dang kun la khyab pa dang / cho 'phrul mi 'gag pa'i phyir nam ma/kha' 'dra ba'o/ /'o na mtshan ma can du mi 'gyur ram zhe na/ 'dis ni yon tan gyi rgyan bstan te mchan ma'i rnam par rtog pas mi g.yo zhing gnyis su med par rtogs pa'i rtags ral pa thor tshugs gcig gis bsgyings pa'o/ /theg pa mchog dang ldan pa'i rtags su glang chen gyi ko rlon gos su gyon pa'o/ khro bo'i gsung ji lta bu zhe na/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa la dgyes pas grags chen ha ha zhes pa'i sgra sgrogs pa/ hi hi zhes sgrogs pas ma rungs pa rnams 'jigs par byed cing brgyal bar byed pa'i gad mo chen po gad rgyangs can/ rdo rje dang 'dra ba gzhan gyis bar du mi chod pas / 'jig rten gsum na thos pa'i rdo rje'i gad mo cher sgrogs pa'o/ /'o na thugs kyi rang bzhin ji lta bu lags she na/rdo rje ltar mi phyed pa'i thugs ye shes chen po chos kyi dbyings la ༵mas pas na sems dpa'/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don la sems

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/dpas sems dpa' che ste/ de'i gong na gzhan med pas rdo rje rgyal po zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po mnga' bas bde ba che/ gdug pa can 'joms pa'i thugs mnga' bas rdo rje drag po des sems can rnams kyi dga' ba chen po skyed par mdzad pas dga' ba che'o/ /rdo rje lta bu thugs su chub pa'i sgo nas rdo rje hūm̐ ste hūm̐ zhes pa'i sgra sgrogs shing gdug pa can tshar gcod par mdzad do/ /khro bo des las ci mdzad ce na/ phyag mtshan mtshon du nyon mongs pa 'bigs pa'i thabs dang shes rab kyi rdo rje'i mda' gzhu thogs pa/ rnam par rtog pa gcod par byed pa'i rdo rje ral gris mtshan rtog ma lus pa gcod par byed pa/dug lnga chom pa'i rtags rdo rje kun 'chang rdo rje ltar gzhan 'joms pa'i mthu dang ldan pas rdo rje can/ de yang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje gcig pu ba/ bdud bzhi dang gdug pa can 'joms shing g.yul sel bar byed pa'o/ /rgyan gyi sgo nas khyad par gyi yon tan bstan pa ni/ rdo rje 'bar ba lta bu'i drag po'i spyan mig shin tu mi bzad pa 'jigs pa mnga' zhing / dbu skra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/gzhan gyi rgyud la sku gsung thugs rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes 'bebs pa rnam par rtog pa med pa 'bebs pa che'o/ /mig brgya pa ste zhes pa mtshon pa tsam ste/ thams cad du ma 'gags pa shes rab kyi spyan 63

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/dbyer mi phyed pa dang ldan pas rdo rje'i mig go /lus la ni rdo rje'i ba spu dngos su 'khyil ba can/ rdo rje'i spu de ni gnyis su me/da pa'i gcig pus sku lus la brgyan pa'o/ /rigs lnga ye shes lnga dbyer mi phyed pa'i rtags su sen mo skyes pa rdo rje'i rtse/ thams cad gnyis su med par bsdus pa'i rtags su rdo rje'i snying po pags pa sra mkhregs 'thas pa mnga' ba'o/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba thogs nas gzhan don mdzad pas dpal dang ldan pa'o/ che ba'i yon tan phreng ba brgyus pa ltar rgyun mi chad pa dang ldan pa'i rtags so/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ zhes da ltar khyad par gyi rgyan rdo rjes brgyan pa'i sgo nas che ba'i yon tan rnams bstan pa yin te/ thugs rdo rje'i rigs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na gsung gi sgo nas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i yon tan gang zhe na/ 'gro ba'i don mjad pa la dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs ha ha zhes nges par sgrog pa/yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra ni rgyas par yi ge drug pa'i sngags/ de las bsdu na wā gi shā ri 'bru drug pa'o/ /de gnyis ni gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa'i sgra'o/ /'jam dbyangs chen po'i gsung don chen po ston pas sgra che ba/ gang du sgrog na 'jig rten gsum na'o/ /sgra gcig pa ni gnyis su med pa ston pa'i sgra yin pa dang / yang ji snyed cig bsgrags kyang 'gro ba 'dren par gcig pa dang / sgra de la yang 'gran zla med 64
