'jam/ dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/dang / /phyis nas sa yi dbang phyug thob/ /gal te las 'phro yod pas na/ /nyi ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /'bring gi gnyis kyis rtogs par 'gyur/ /nyi ma gsum gyis bsgrubs pas ni/ /las 'phro med kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /nyi ma shar dang me tog thu// zhing rmos snag cha 'thung ba dang / /nyams dga' yi ge bri klog dang / /mchod cha pu ti rnyed rmis na/ /shes rab 'phel ba the tshom med/ /de skad rgya gar paṇ+ḍi ta/ /ka ma shī las gsungs pa yin/ /rgya gar yul gyi mi rgan ni/ /lo ni dgu bcu go dgu pa/ /yi ge yang ni mi shes pas/ /zhag gcig bsgrubs pas 'jam dbyangs mjal/ /lus kyang gzhon nu lo brgyad tsam/ /rigs pa'i gnas lnga thogs med shes//paṇ+ḍi ta ni mkhas par gyur/ /de la pha gcig dam pas zhus/ /rim gyis brgyud de karma pa/ /dbang phyug rdo rjes mjad pa yi/ /gcig shes kun grol nang na bzhugs/ /'jam dbyangs sgrub pa thams cad la/ /'di las 'grub thag nye ba med/ /'di yi las tshogs shes rab kyis/ /ril bu sngar dus bdag gis bsgrub/ /sus zos phal cher mkhas par 'gyur/ /de phyir da lam snying gi bu/ /pad+ma phrin las thugs dam yin//sngags kyi bsnyen pa ci sogs kyis/ /yon tan shugs la mkhas par 'gyur/ /bstan 'dzin 'gro don nus pa yi/ /ge mo bla ma zhes bya ba/ /mkhas pa chen por 'gyur bar shog /sarba maṅga lo/ yi ge'i sgyu 'phrul chu zla'i rol gar can/ /dpal spungs gdan sar spar du bskrun pa'i dges/ /'gro ba kun gyi rmongs ba'i mun sel nas/ /byang chub myur du thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /ces 'khor gsum dri ma bral ba'i ngang nas lha dpal gyis smras pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel// //127

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/༄༅/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod pa/swa sti/ mtshams sprin gzhon nu'i mdangs bzhin mdzes pa'i sku/ /'chi med bdag po'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa'i gsung / /chu gter chen po'i klung bzhin zab pa'i thugs/ /'jam dbyangs rgyal ba'i yab la phyag 'tshasnyel 61/ /rab 'byams bskal bar grangs med rgyal ba la/ /rab 'byams zhing du dpag med legs bshad tshogs/ /rab 'byams brtson pas thos pa'i mthar son pa'i/ /mtshungs med mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug khyod la 'dud/ /'khor ba'i tha ma'i mtshams gang ji srid pa/ /de srid nyam thag 'gro kun bskyab pa'i phyir/ /sems can khur chen khyer bas mi ngal ba'i/ /mtshungs med snying rje'i dbang phyug khyod la 'dud/ /rgyal sras thu bo'i sku yis zhing kun tu/ /rmad byung bkod pa'i mdzad pas rgya mtsho las/ /skra rtses blangs pa'i cha shas phra mo tsam//mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don du 'di bkod pas/ /che rabs kun tu rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /theg mchog ston pa'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa dang / /sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byang ba'i drin can rnams/ /ma lus sgrol la 'jam dbyangs 'dra bar shog /128

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/༄tsho/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i rgyud kyi bklag thabs ye shes sdi/ba ster zhes bya ba/na mo gu ru dz+nyā na kā yā ya/ 'dir 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa gdon pa'i gdams ngag la rnam pa bzhir gsungs pa las zab mo'i rnal 'byor la gzhol bar mi nus pa'i las dang po pa'am/ rnal 'byor zab mo la 'jug pas kyang thun mtshams rnams su che ba'i yon tan la bsngags pa'i tshul gyis gdon par 'dod pas dad pa dang / nges 'byung dang / byang chub kyi sems gnyis yid la byas te/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /gzhan don rdzogs byang thob bya'i phyir/ /zab mo'i rgyud sde bklag par bgyi/ /lan gsum gyis skyabs sems bya/ /rang mdun nam mkhar yid 'phrog pa'i/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis/ /rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /sku mdog gser gyi lhun po ni/ /mtshams sprin gsar bas 'khyud bzhin mdzes/ /zhi 'dzum brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i dpal/ /ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i phung por 'bar/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis/ /shes rab ral gri glegs bam dang / /'og mas thabs shes mda' gzhu bsnams/ /zla ba'i rgyab yol la brten nas/ /129

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /sna tshogs dar gyi sha/ma thabs dang / /rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /zur phuda.āt+pa lar gnas pa'i/ /mi bskyod rigs kyi bdag por bcas/ /mkha' lam dbang po'i gzhu lta bu/ /snang stong zung 'jug ye shes sku/ /mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ /e ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal tshangs dbang sogs/ /srid zhi'i nyams 'gyur ji snyed kun/ /'jam pa'i dpal las gzhan min phyir/ /mtha' yas shes bya'i rjes song ba'i/ /mtshan dang sku yi bkod pa dang / /yon tan mkha' dang snyoms 'jug par/ /mi phyed mchog tu gus pa'i blos/ /ngag gi nor bu'i tam+bu ra/ /ye shes lus can 'jam dpal gyi/ /rdo rje'i mtshan don yang dag par/ /brjod pa'i gdangs su 'phos pa yis/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rgyud bskul bas/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer dpag yas pa/ /sa gsum khyab par rab tu 'phros/ /bdag dang yid can thams cad kyis/ /thog med nas bsags sdig lhung dang / /sgrib gnyis mun pa kun bsal nas/ /ji lta ji snyed shes bya la/ /blo mchog/ pad+mo rgyas par gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsams la/ mos gusartse gcig gis rgyud kyi rgyal po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mchan yang dag par brjod pa tshar gsum sogs ci nus su bklags/ spro na/ oṃ sarba dharmā bhā wa sogs kyi sngags ci 130

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/rigs par bzla zhing phan yon kyang gdon par gsungs/ gang ltar yang mthar/dngos dang yid las byung ba yi/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshos/ /srid pa mthar byas de srid du/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu mnyes gyur cig /oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra twe ts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /ye shes phung po gcig bsdus pa/ /srid zhi kun gyi dpal gyur pa'i/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po khyod kyi rdo rje'i mchan/ /yang dag brjod pas rab bsngags bdag /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dgyes bzhin rjes su gzung bar mdzod/ /gnas skabs tshul gnas thos bsam dang / /sgom pa'i blo gros rab rgyas shing / /'chad rtsod rtsom la mtshungs med pa'i/ /smra ba'i nyi mar byin gyis rlobs/ /mthar thug shes dang shes bya kun/ /mi phyed ye shes sku thob nas/ /'gro rnams 'jam dpal gzhon nu yi/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god gyur cig /ces gsol ba gdab/ gzod nas spros bral 'jam pa'i dpal/ /rten 'byung sgyu ma'i ngang tshul gyis/ /snang char shar ba'i ye shes pa/ /rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /'di bsgrubasapa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa/ /des ni skye bo thamasacad kyis/ /bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /131

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/ces sogs bsngo smon ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ /yang mchan bcas kyi rnal 'byor la gtso bor gzhol bas 'jam dpal pa rnal 'byor gyis gdon na/skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dhi3 haṃ/stong ba'i ngang las rang nyid ni/ /pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis/ /zhes pa nas mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ /ces pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng / /skye med don mtshon a dkar po/ /de las rdo rje'i tshig gi rgyud/ /rten 'byung sgra brnyan lta bu'i tshul/ /skyes tsam nyid nas skye 'gags sogs/ /spros pa'i mtshan ma ma dmigs pa/ /zab gsal gnyis med ye shes sku/ /rjes su dran pa'i ngang nas bklag /ces gsal btab nas rgyud ci nus su bton ma/thar/'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /zhes sogs bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab ste thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go/ /yang na yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis gdon pa ni/rang gi rgyun gyi yi dam gang la'ang sbyar du rung bas/ de'i bdag bskyed gsal btab pa'i rjes/ khro bo yin na/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng / zhes bsgyur ba ma gtogs dmigs pa sogs sngar bzhin no/ /yang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la gtso bor gzhol bas bdag med pa'i ngang nas gdon pa ni/ /skyabs sems sngon tu 'akro bas/ chos thams cad rmi lam dang sgra brnyan dang brag ca lta bur shes par byas la ma yengs pa'i ngang nas gdon cing dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o/ /de thams cad kyi don mdor bsdus pa'i chul gyis gdon na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon tu 'gro bas/thog mar 'jam dpal gyi rnal 'byor gyis 'don pa'i skabs ltar bdag nyid lhar 132

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/gsal gdab/ de nas mdun du lha gsal gdab pa sogs che ba'i yon tan la bsngags pa'i tshul gyis rgyud gdon pa la 'jug /de dag gi gnas skabasathams cad du lusa'aja' tshon/ ngag brag ca/ sems spros bral nam mkha' lta bur shes par bya/mthar mchod bstod gsol ba gdab pa sogs sbyar ro/ /'di rnams kyi khungs ni rje btsun rin po ches rgyud kyi lung sbyor mdzad pa ltar dang / der ma zad 'khor lo bzhi pa'i rjes su bsngags pa las/ mtshan gyi don phan tshun re re zhing yang 'jam dpal ye shes kyi sku mngon du byas te/ rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis sgom par byed pa dang / lhag par mos pa dang / bdag nyid ltar che ba'i yon tan/ bdag med pa'i de kho na nyid yid la byed pa dag gis zhes gsungs pas kyang rim bzhin du bstan par bzhed do/ /de ltar dus gsum du brtson pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob pa dang / spobs pa sgrub pa dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dgongs par 'gyur ba dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams kyis bsrung zhing bskyab pa dang / tshe rabs kun tu mi khom par mi skye zhing 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung ba dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis 'byor par 'gyur ba dang / gzungs dang blo gros dang / tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa mtha' yas pa dang ldan zhing mi nyams pa dang / gong nas gong du 'phel ba la brten nas myur du rdzo gas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par 'gyur bas mtshon phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul rgya cher phan yon gyi rjes su bsngags pa'i skabs rnams las 'byung ba ltar shes par byas nas blo ldan rnams kyis 'di kho na la rtse gcig tu brtson par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rang gzhan la nye bar mkho ba'i phyir mang du thos pa'i bya bral pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab la gzhi byas/ 'jam 133

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/mgon sa skya paṇa ḍa'i gsung sgros zin bris sogs las kyang cung zad bsnan te shin tu gsal bar bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig /sarba dā ka myu ṇ+ḍaṃ bha ba tu// //༄༅/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod sgrub 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba bsdo/gas/na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ blo ldan gang zhig mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi yon tan mtha' dag gi rtsa bar gyur pa dri ma med pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i slad du/ grub pa'i slob dpon rdo rje mtshon chas mdzad pa'i dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po'i bstod pa'i sgrub thabs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ sngon du brgyud/ ldan gyi bla ma las 'di'i rig gtad legs par nos te/ nges 'byung dang snying rje chen po'i blo shugs drag tu skyed bzhin pa'i ngang nyams len gyi rim pa la 'jug par bya'o/ /de la'ang spyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba skyabs sems ni/ bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub bar du bla ma mchog gsum skyabs su bsnyen//gzhan don rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir 'jam dpal bstod sgrub nyams blangs mthus/ /yid can bde ba rgyur bcas dang ldan sdug bsngal rgyur bcas kun dang bral/ /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde dang mi 'bral btang snyoms ngang la gnas gyur cig /lan gsum/ dngos gzhi 134

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/bsgom bzlas ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dh+warmāḥswa bha wa shuzlo3haṃ/ 'di ltar dngos kun bdag dang phung po rnam rig spros pa las 'das kyang / /rten cing 'brel 'byung snang cha 'gag med sgyu ma'i tshul la snyoms 'jug bzhin/ /rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang snying dbus zla steng dhīḥyig las/ /'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'jam dpal gzhon du ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa ni/ /gur gum mdangs can brgyad gnyis lang tshor mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar/ /gnag snum dbu skra zur phud lnga ldan snyan gong ut+pal chun pos mdzes/ /phyag g.yas ye shes ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon pas sher phyin glegs bam bsnams/ /sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rgyan spras zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs dbus zla steng dhīḥ yig dmar ser 'bar bas mtshan/ /slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs ye shes bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas/ /sku gang sgrib dag mi bskyod dbur brgyan gus pas bstod cing gsol btab mthus/ /thugs srog nyid las bstod pa'i tshig dang sngags kyi phreng ba bar med 'phros/ /nyin mor byed pa'i 'od ltar gsal ba bdag gi snying dbus thim pa'i mod/ /mi shes mun pa mtha' dag 135

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/bsal nas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i snang ba yis/ /rig dang brtse ba'i pad+mo rab rgyas 'jam mgon go 'phang thob par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal bas/ /ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin/ /gang dag srid pa'i btson rar ma rig mun 'thums sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/ /'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung / /'brug ltar cher sgrogs nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog 'grol mdzad cing //ma rig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams/ /gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogan+da/ rgyal sras thu bo'i sku/ /bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mu/na sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/'a na gsum/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhiḥdape la lar hūm̐ swā hā zhes snang na'ang dpe rnying phal cher du dkyus su bkod pa bzhin no/ /nyer gcig slar yang de 'dra tshar gnyis te bstod pa dgu phrugs su bya ba'am/ bstod pa bdun nam nyer gcig sogs kyi mthar bzlas pa ci nus su bya ste/ rgyun du 'di tsam gyis don 'grub la bstod sgrub dmigs bsal byed na ji skad bshad pa'i rim pas bstod pa khri phrag bdun bzla bar phan yon gyi mchan rnying las bshad la/ sngags 'bum phrag lnga'am bdun bzla'o/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ bstod pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ brtse ldan smra ba'i nyi ma khyod kyi mkhyen rab thugs 136

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/ rje'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag blo'i nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas/ /legs gasdo/ngas bka' dang dgongs 'grel bstan bcos gzhung lugs ji bzhin rtogs pa yi/ /blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bskyed nas kun mkhyen thob par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes 'dod don la rtse gcig tu gsol ba gdab/ mdun gyi lha rang la bstims pa'am mi dmigs par bsams nas bdag med gnyis kyi nges pas drangs ba'i zhi lhag zung 'jug gi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par gzhag /de las ldang ba na/ dge ba 'di yis tshogs gnyis sbyor bas bdag med don la gsal snang thob/ /de mthus spros bral 'jam dpal ye shes 'phags blos mngon sum nyid du mthong / /kun brtags lhan skyes nyon mongs rnams spangs rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /shes bya'i/ sgrib pa cha bcas mthar byas bde gshegs shes rab thob par rberteg /ces bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug /thun mtshams rnams su'ang stong nyid snying rje'i snying po dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas spyod lam thams cad don yod par bya ste/ de ltar 'bad pas ring por mi thogs par srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das pa'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o/ /zhes pa'ang mang du thos pa'i btsun pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos rang gzhan rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas yig rnying mtha' dag gi don gyi bcud phyung ste sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos rjes bla ma ā nan+da mañdzu gho /sa mdzad pa ste/ 'dis kyang 'gro kun so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i ye shes la dbang 'byor ba'i rgyur gyur cig /sasdo ste

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/kaphywa khaṃ bha ba tu// //༄༅/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rnam thar phyogs gcig gi cha shas la cung zad bsngags pa nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po dbyer med pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjes su sgrog pa'i sprin gyi char zhes bya ba bzhugs rbe1/ /na mo ār+yā mañdzu shrī ye/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs la rtag bzhugs/ shing / /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gang yin pa/ /de ni 'jam dpa'/ ye shes sems dpa' ste/ /bdag gi snying la ye shes dbab tu gsol//rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi dbang phyug ste/ /brjod med brjod pa gzhom du med pa'i rgyu/ /chos 'khor ma lus smra ba'i tshig gi bdag /bdud rtsi'i zeg ma bdag la stsal du gsol/ /rgyal kun ye shes sku ste 'jam pa'i dpal/ /sgrib pa kun spangs rang byung gzhon nu'i lus/ /mtshan dpe nyi ma zla ba snang ba'i 'od/ /bdag la zhal gyi cha shas bstan tu gsol/ /mkha' khyab 'gog pa'i bden pa rdul spangs pa/ /rnam grol 138

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/lus kyis gdod nas mngon mdzad kyang / /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyab cing rtag pa yi/ /khyab bdag chen pos bdag gi bla ma mdzod/ /rgyal sras ye shes yangs pa'i go 'byed cing / /mtshan ma med pa ci yang mi rtog pa'i/ /rnam thar chos kyi dbyings dang snyoms par zhugs/ /nam mkha' 'dra bas bdag la go skabs phyes/ /btang snyoms chen pos 'khor 'das khur khyer zhing / /bsdu ba rab yangs 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /yon tan lo tog du ma skyed mdzad pa'i/ /sa chen 'dra bas bdag kyang smin mdzad gsol/ /sgrib pa'i sprin dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /kha dog sna tshogs snang bar 'bar ba yis/ /nyon mongs rgya mtsho yud tsam nyid la skems/ /nyi ma 'dra bas sdig pa'i mun pa sol/ /shes rab dkyil 'khor snying rje'i bsil zer can/ /chos nyid mkha' la chags pa med par shar/ /blo chen skar ma'i dbus na nya rgyas kyi/ /zla ba 'dra bas bdag la snang ba stsol/ /tshogs gnyis dpag yas rin chen mdzod mnga' zhing / /srid dang zhi ba'i gling la rang dbang sgyur/ /mnyam med rnam thar gser gyi 'khor los 'dren/ /chos kyi rgyal pos bdag la bka' lung stsol/ /bde ba'i spyad pa spyod 'dod don mthun gyi/ /rgyal sras gzhon nu srid lam dub pa la/ /shes rab gter kha zad pa med pa spyin/ /bum bzang 'dra bas bdag 139

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/gi dbul sel mdzod/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba 'gro khams sa gzhir zug /smon lam rgya mtsho'i lo ma 'bras bus dud/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'dod pa 'jo/ /ljon shing 'dra bas bdag gi grib bsil mdzod/ /dbang bcu'i pha mthar son pa'i zil dngar dang / /stobs bcu'i nus pas 'chi bdag tshar gcod pa/ /sar gnas nye dbang tshogs kyi spyad bya ste/ /bdud rtsi 'dra bas bdag gi 'chi ba sol mi shes pa dang le lo'i gnyid slong zhing / /bden bzhi'i sgra yis log zhugs rnal mar 'god/ /gdul dka' tshar gcod mi srun btang snyoms mdzad/ /rnga chen 'dra bas bdag gi bag med sol / /byang sems bye ba snyed la gtam ston zhing / /lha sogs mngon par dga' ba'i grags pa can/ /'jig rten gsum na mtshan gyi sgra gcig pa/ /'brug sgra 'dra bas bdag la chos char stsol/ /gzung 'jin rab tu brtan pa'i khang pa na/ /sdig lta'i mun pas nyams pa'i byis pa la/ /lhag par ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /'gro ba'i mar mer gyur pas drang du gsol/ /phung sogs dngos po'i tshang tshing kun za ba/ /mkhyen rab dri med 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /chags thogs med pa'i ye shes me lte yis/ /bdag gi las nyon sgrib pa bsreg tu gsol/ /yang dag lta bas 'gro la gzigs gzigs nas/ /las kyi 'khrul 'khesar 140

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/sgyu ma lta bur mkhyen/ /rab rib spangs pas lta ba'i skyon med pa/ /ye shes mig gcig bdag la gzigs su gsol/ /ting 'dzin bud med khrag khrig brgyas bskor yang / /mi gnas tshangs par spyod las mnyams par/ /bcing grol med pa'i khrims kyi lung 'bogs pa/ /gtsang gnas dam pas bdag la tshangs pa stsole/ /'khor ba rgyu dang bcas pa thugs chud pas/ /gang gang nyes pa'i gsog ldang de dang de/ /gang 'dul sbyor ba brgya pas rtsad nas phyung / /sman pa chen pos bdag gi zug rngu choms/ /spros pa kun bral de bzhin nyid kyi mtshor/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i gru la rtag zhon te/ /'khor ba ji srid 'gro kun sgrol la zhugs/ /de/da dpon chen pos bdag kyang bsgral du gsol/ /byams dang bzod pa sra ba'i go mnabs te/ /shes bcu'i mtshon chas bdud dang gshin rje sogs/ /mi bzad g.yul ngo zlog mdzad 'jigs chen dgra/ /dpa' po chen pos bdag gi 'jigs pa sol/ /dus su btang snyoms skad cig mi mnga' zhing / /dus min rtsol bcas phrin las mi mdzad par/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes dusal rtag tu dgongs/ / dus shes chen pos bdag gi dus mkhyen mdzod/ /lam gyi rgyud las yang dag 'das gyur kyang / /lam dang lam ma yin la shin tu mkhas/ /dbang lam tha dad ston la mi bsnyengs pa/ /bdag 141

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thaban+da// la'ang byang chub chen po'i shul bstan gsol/ /'khrul dang grol ba 'ga' yang ma gzigs kyang / /sdug bsngal 'khor lo rdo rje rnon pos gcod/ /'gro ba rgyud lnga dben la rab bzhag pa/ /brtan pa'i 'khor los bdag gi 'khrul pa sol/ /kun tu dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin dang / /rdzu 'phrul rnam par brtse ba'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /theg chen/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan kun tu bcugs/ /theg pa dam pa'i bzhon par bdag bskyon gsol/ /rgyal ba kun gyi chos sgo mtha' yas pa/ /stong pa nyid las brtsams te smra mkhas pas/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog tshig gis mi 'phrog pa/ /bdag la zab mo rtogs pa'i blo gros stsal/ /'du byed mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid brnyas pas/ /chos rnams kun la de blo mnyam par bzhag /dngos dang dngos med kun las rnam grol bas/ /bdag kyang mtshan ma med la gzhug tu gsol/ /bdag med rtogs pa seng ge'i sgras bsgrags nas/ /mtshan ma brgya phrag rnam pa kun tu bzhigs/ /sgyu ma'i chos te sgyu ma las kyang grol/ /bdag sogs spros pa'i 'chings las dgrol bar mdzod/ /rkang gnyis mchog ma sngar gshegs thams cad kyis/ /khyod kyi mthu ni rtag tu bstan par mdzod//byung dang 'byung 'gyur kun kyang de bzhin te/ /mthu stobs chen pos ngan 'gro las bskyab gsol/ /thub pa 'das nas dam chos bsrung ba 142

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/dang / /'gro la dbugs 'byin chen po stsal 'dod pas/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pas dus kun rgyu lags na/ /bdag kyang 'khor ba'i mtsho las dbugs dbyung stsol/ /gang du 'jig rten 'dren pas dben pa na/ /byis pa'i gzugs kyis sangs rgyas mdzad pa mdzad/ /dus dang dus su rgyal bstan khur bsnams pas/ /skal dman bdag gi 'dren pa mdzad du gsol/ /dus mthar sems can kun la mchog spyin zhing / /sngags kyi gzugs kyis skye bo skyabs med pa/ /skyob pa'i go cha rgyal rnams mdun bzhes pas/ /sgrub po bdag la mchog gi grub pa stsol/ /stobs bcu mnga' bas mgrin gcig gsol ba'i mtshan/ /'jam dpal zhes bya thos dang dran pa yang / /bsod nams phung po bsam gyis mi khyab gsungs/ /bdag kyang mtshan gyi yi ges byin brlab mjod/ /zab mos shes rab bsam mi khyab bsags pas/ /'jig rten chos la rdul tsam mi bsten par/ /chos kyi rgyal thabs dbang sgyur chen po pa/ /bdag kyang chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur gsol/ /dbyibs dang kha dog cha lug mi mnga' yang / /dri med dpal 'bar gzi brjid phreng ba can/ /chu zla bzhin tu bzung ba ma mchis pas/ /bdag la'ang bsod nams chen po'i gzi brjid stsol/ /'das pa'i dus su rgyal ba 'jam pa'i tog /ma 'ongs dus na mgon po kun tu 143

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/gzigs/ /da lta mos pa rab dga'i snying po sogs/ /rgyal ba rgya mtshos ma rig sbubs brtol zhing / /sangs rgyas spyan gyis gzigs pa'i rdul snyed kyi/ /zhing khams kun tu na ma phrul tshad med pas/ /ngo mtshar chen po'i spyod la rab zhugs pa/ /rgyal sras rgya mtshos srid mtha' dbyings su brtul/ /mgon po khyod ni rgyal ba kun gyi yab/ /yon tan chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pas brgyan/ /sgrub pa gnyis po ngag gi mthar gshegs kyang / /da dung sems can kho na'i don la dgyes/ /rgyal ba bye bas gsungs kyang skra rtse yi/ /zeg ma tsam gyur rnam thar rgya mtsho la/ /bdag ltas bsngags pa'i cal col 'bum sgrogs kyang / /phyogs su mi nye char yang mi phyin mod/ /nyi zla'i snang bas gzhan gyi mig phye la/ /srin bus rang gi shul lam mtshon pa ltar//rang nyid kho na dad pa'i shul mtshon pa'i/ /tshig gi sgron me 'jam mgon thugs rjes bzhes/ /'od kyi tog dang ye shes bla ma mchog /zhi ba'i dbang po smon lam blo gros sogs/ /blo chen khyod dang mtshungs par spyod pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i rjes su slob//mos pa'i dge bas snying gi mun bcom nas/ /da lta nyid du 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i sku/ /rdzu 'phrul che zhing kha dog bzang po can/ /mngon sum dbang po'i yul du gyur bar mdzod/ /srid pa shul ring 144

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/mgron po'i dbugs 'byin cing / /bsod nams brgya ba'i rtsibs kyi ri mo can/ /phyag mthil bdag gi mgo la nyug mdzad nas/ /byang chub bar du bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter chen gyi pho brang dang khad nye zhing mi rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis gtsug lag gi blo gros gsal ba shar phyogs rnam dag bkod pa'i ljongs su 'du gsum pa blo gros mtha' yas kyis dad pas bris pa skye ba kun tu 'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅgalam̐// //༄༅/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bstod pa dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/swa sti/ dge mtshan bye ba'i 'od 'bar lhun po'i dbang / /thun mtshams gsar pa'i rtse dga' la 'grogs pa'i/ /dpal gyis mngon mtho zur phud lnga pa zhes/ /grags dkar g.yo ba gang der bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed zhing gi yid can kun/ /sgrol ba'i khur chen 'khyer la mi ngal zhing / /dam chos 'dzin pa'i snying stobs phul byung ba/ /skyob pa mtshungs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun khyab kun gyi rang bzhin gdod ma'i gshis/ /mtshan ma'i spros pa kun bral 'od gsal ngang / /gnyis med lhan skyes dga' ba'i rol pa che /145

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'gre'/ mchan dang sgrub thabs/'jam dpal gdod ma'i mgon por phyag 'tshal lo/ /skal ldan mos blo'i rdzing bu bye ba brgyar/ /gsang gsum zlos gar brtan g.yo'i zla snang 'bum/ /gcig dang du mar spro zhing sdud mdzad pa/ /'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa bar phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pas shes bya'i pha mtha' sgrib med gzigs/ /brtse bas 'akro kun bu sdug lta bur byams/ /mtshan tsam gyis kyang nyon mongs drungs 'byin pa/ /'jam/ dpal gzhon nu'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye bar mgon khyod skyabs su bsten pa bdag /rgya che zab gsal myur ba'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi gnad don rnams/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa'i spobs pa mchog stsol cig /zab rgyas lam gyi rim pa ma lus pa/ /'dzin cing spel la snying stobs phul byung bas/ /mgon po khyod bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i 'os su bdag gyur cig /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i 'gro ba sgrol ba la/ /rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i kun bzang spyod pa dang / /smon lam rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs pa yis/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor ngoms med spyod gyur cig /gnas skabs dam chos bsgrub pa'i phyi nang bgegs/ /nag po'i phyogs kyis nam yang mi brdzi zhing / /yid la gang bsams chos ldan mthun pa'i rkyen/ /'bad med lhan gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /146

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/zhes rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la bstod pa dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni dad brtson rnam dpyod phul du byung ba'i ja sag bla ma chos 'phel dar rgyas dang / tā bla ma bka' chen bkra shis yar 'phel gnyis kyis bskul ba dang /rang nyid kyis kyang mchog tu dad pas mtshams sbyar te/ snyom las pa dge slong ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rjer grags pas rje btsun nyid kyi sprul pa'i gnas mchog ri bo rtse lngar sbyar ba'i yi ge nga/ ni zhabs drung bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos bgyis pa'i dge bas rang gzhan thams cad rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis rjes su 'jin par gyur cig/ //༄༅/ /mdo mkhyen brtses mjad pa'i 'jam dpal hā/ba thabs/sa: bla ma mgon po 'jam dbyangs la: skyabs gsol byang chub sems macedrog bskyed: phyag 'tshal mabyerten 'bul sdig pa nga'inags: yi rang chos bskul gsol ba 'debs: dus gsum dge tshogs 'gro la bsngo: stong nyid snying rje'i rang gdangs las: 'o mtsho pad sdong nyi zla'i dbus: rang nyid bcom ldan 'jam dpal dbyangs: dri med dung mdog zhi 'dzum mdzes: mchod sbyin dkon mchog gsum mtshon rgyas:g.yas g.yon ut+pal ral pod 'dzin: thor tshug rin chen dar gos brgyan: sems dpa'i skyil krung dang bcas te: shes rab lha mo 'du 147

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/'bral med: lhang nge lha ne 'od zer 'bar: dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med: thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i: lte bar dhi:dang rtsibs snying po: g.yas su 'bor ba'i 'od zer gyis: shes rab mchog dang mi brjed gzungs: mchog thun dngos grub thob par dmigs: brtse ldan khyod kyi shes rab 'od zer gyis: bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas: thegs rab rnam gasdo/ma gzhan snang zil gnon cing: blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bskyed du gsol: oṃ dhi rī:wa kye rda na ma: cis nus bzla'o/ /thun mthar/mgon po 'jam dpal yab yum la: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub zhu: bdag gi bla mar mdzad du gsol: yang gsang thugs thig cha lag las: 'jam dpal rnon po'i sgrub pa ni: khrag 'thung las kyi dpa' bos smras: rig rtsal me lta ra 'bar bar nges: chos rgyal zhabs pad brtan gyur cig: khams gsum dbang sdud zil gnon rgya: dge'o// //༄༅/ /'jam dpal bstod pa byin rlabs gter chen bsdokyigs/skyetshe/ sku mchog 'jam dpal gzhon nur phyag 'tshal 31/ /148

'jam dpal mchan/ brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/'jam dbyangs gsung dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rab ye shes sems dpar phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal kun ye shes rdo rjer phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes ral gri 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo thabs kyi ut+pal bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab mda' rnon 'phen la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje'i gzhu chen 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gis mgon po 'jam dbyangs khyod dran te/ /gus pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs lags na/ /thugs dam chen pos nye bar rjes bzungs nas/ /spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol bar mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhī:hūm̐/ dge'o/ /༄༅/ /lags par bshad pa ngag rin po che'i mdzod kyi cha shas ci rigs pa bzhugs/ /bstod pa bkra shis mi 'gyur ma yod do/ /oṃ bkra shis mi 'gyur dkon mchog gsum/ /gang las byung zhing 'phro ba'i gnas/ /skyabs kyi dam pa skyabs su 'os/ /'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /phyogs dus 'gro ba'i snang ngo dang / /mthun par sgyu ma'i gar mdzad kyang / /brtag na shes bya gang du'ang / /mi gnas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo zhi 149

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/ba'i nang na zhi ba ste/ /'jam dpal zug rngu med pa'i mchog /mkha' khyab snying rje chen/ po'i sku/ /gzhon nur rol pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /khro bo'i nang na khro bo ste/ /thams cad mthar byed gshin rje'i gshed/ /srid zhi dbyings su za ba'i zhal/ /dus kyi dgra chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /snang stong mi phyed rdo rje'i sku/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i ye shes dngos/ /khyab bdag kun tu bzang po ni/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod byas pa'i/ /dge bas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /'jam pa'i dpal gyi ye shes 'od/ /snying gi pad+mor sim gyur cig /'jam dpal zhi khro'i rgyud sde kun gyi ni/ /snying po yongs su dril te gang bstod pa/ /'jam dpal bstod pa kun gyi nang na ni/ /snying la gcigs su bya ba 'di lags/ so/ /mkha' ltar zab cing rgya che ba'i rmad du byung ba rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar kun nas 'byed pa'i bstod pa 'di rab ches shing byi lor mi pham pas spel ba dge zhing bkra shis pa mi zad rtag tu 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig /a the/ maṅga lo//༄༅/ /lha mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pa tam+bu ra yi dbyangs snyan bsdokyigs/ /hrīḥ tshangs pa'i yid kyi sras mo ni/ /rol pa'i mtsho chen las byung ba/ /zla ltar dkar ba'i zhal mnga' ma/ /dbyangs can lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rig byed gsang chig 'jad med gter/ /de 150

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/bzhin gshegs gsung chos phung che/ /'chi med lam yang mthar khyab byed/ /dbyangs kyi dpal mor gus pas 'dud/ /tam bu ra la 'khyud byas te/ /sor rtses dal gyis bsgrengs pa yis/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kun/ /yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog la 'dud/ /nges don shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rnam pa lha mo'i gzugs su bsgyur/ /ngo mchar sgyu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen mor 'dud//de bzhin gshegs kun rjes chags kyis/ /ye shes spyan gyis zur mda' g.yo/ /snyoms zhugs bde chen mchod sprin bstod/ /dgyes yum chen mor gus pas 'dud/ /blo ldan gang gi mgrin snying la/ /zhugs pa de yi mod nyid du/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug chen por bsgyur/ /blo gros mchog stsol ma la bstod/ /de ltar bstod pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag yid dad pa'i 'o mtsho sa /bzhugs nas mkhyen gnyis ye shes kyi/ /snang ba chen po stsal du gsol/ /oṃ pi cu pi tsu pra dz+nyā war+bha ni/ ja la dz+wa la me dhi war+bha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri sau war+bha ni swā hā/ /zhes bzlas blo gros 'phel ba byed/ /ces pa'ang rje dbon bsam btan sprul sku rin po ches rten bcas gsung gis bskul ngor 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros nas dpal spungs yid dga' chos 'jin dbyangs can grub pa'i dga' tshal du bris pa dge legs 'phel/151

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/༄༅/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs shes rab nyin byed snang ba zhes bya ba bsdokyigs/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus gar/ /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo snang ba'i mdzod/ /sa gsum bla ma 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig mchog /gang dang dbyer med 'jam dpal dbyangs la 'dud/ /de la 'dir rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus shig bri ba la/ sbyor nga/ngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la'ang gnyis te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / yan lag bdun pa'o/ /dang po ni/ na mo/sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun 'dus pa'i/ /'jam dpal dbyangs la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro rnams byang chub thob phyir du/ /'jam dpal sgrub la brtson par bgyi/ /gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa ni/dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs/ /mi zad mdzod kyi 'khor lor 'bul/ /zhing gi rdul snyed sdo/sa sprul nas/ /sgo gan+da/ma gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcas rang kha na ma tho kun/ gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i semasakyisabashags/ /dmigs med ye shes dam pa dang / /bsod nams dge la yi rang ngo / /rigs can rnams la gang 'tsham par/ /chos kyi 'khor ༵ zloskor bar bskul/ /dam pa mya ngan 'da' bzhed rnams/ /ji srid

'jam dpal mchan brjod kyi 'grel mchan dang sgrub thabs/bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs ci bsags pa/ /bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rim pa ni/rang mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od klong / /pad zla'i gdan la skad cig gis/ /'phags mchog rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzabyem zhal can/ /phyag g.yas ral gri gasku1na pad+ma/ /zhabs gnyis skyil krung longs spyod rdzogs/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /stong gsal 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can/ /sangs rgyas byang sems grub pa'i tshogs/ /rnams kyis yongs su bskor bar bsams/ /thugs dbus zla steng dhīḥyig las/ /'od 'phros bdag la thim pa yis/ /mchog thun dngos grub kun thob nas/ /sgrib gnyis mun pa kun sel zhing / /shes bya'i gnas rnams mkhyen pa yi/ /spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol ba dang / /don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par re|ga /oṃ aḥr pa tsa na dhīḥzhes bzlas mthar/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la bzhi ste/ dang po mchod bstod bya ba ni/snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /ting 'dzin mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /bkang ste rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la/ /mchod pas bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shog /oṃ ar+ya mañdzu shrī ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/shabha pra ti tsa swā hā/ sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /phrin las gcig bsdus 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rje 153

'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi 'grel mchan/ dang sgrub thabs/btsun 'jam dpal dpa' bo la/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gnyis pa gsol gdab bya ba ni/ deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje btsun khyed kyis rjes bzung nas/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs med pa'i/ /smra ba'i dbang phyug shes rab stsol/ /gsum pa bsdu rim ni/gzod nas rten 'byung snang brnyan du/ /shar ba'i ye shes sgyu ma'i sku/ /spros bral 'jam dbyangs khyed nyid ni/ /ma bcos de bzhin klong du thim/ /bzhi pa dge ba bsngo ba ni/'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /dge rtsa ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /'gro rnams 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi / go 'phang mchog la 'god phyir bsngo/ /rmad byung shes rab gsum gyi gru bo cher/ /'gro kun zhugs shing smon lam gser dbyug gus/ /bskul nas srid pa'i rgya mtsho las brgal zhing / /gdod ma'i rgyal srid zin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces 'jam dpal sgrub thabs shes rab nyin byed snang ba ridi nyid snga sor nas 'bri 'dun yod kyang phyis su bde chen dri med kyis bskul ngor thub bstan lung rigs smra ba'i nyi mas bris pa 'dis/ 'gro kun 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ngo bo ka nas dag pa chos kyi sku/ /mkhyen cha lhun grub 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje phyogs ris med pa sprul pa'i sku/ /sku gsum dbyer med 'jigs med gling pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so gnas lugs rtogs par shog /ces pa 'di yang thub bstan lung rigs smra ba'i nyi mas bris pa'o//154
